color: \"#DCEDC8\" },\n    { x: 240, y: 150 + values.personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: values.other * unitHeight, label: \"その他\", value: values.other, color: \"#F0F4C3\" },\n    { x: 160, y: 150 + values.fixed * unitHeight, w: 160, h: values.profit * unitHeight, label: \"利益\", value: values.profit, color: \"#BBDEFB\" }\n  ];\n\n  blocks.forEach(d => {\n    d.x += baseX;\n    d.y += baseY;\n  });\n\n  const width = d3.max(blocks, d => d.x + d.w) + marginX;\n  const height = d3.max(blocks, d => d.y + d.h) + marginY;\n\n  const svg = d3.select(\"#chart\")\n    .attr(\"width\", width)\n    .attr(\"height\", height);\n\n  svg.selectAll(\"rect\")\n    .data(blocks)\n    .enter()\n    .append(\"rect\")\n    .attr(\"x\", d => d.x)\n    .attr(\"y\", d => d.y)\n    .attr(\"width\", d => .data(blocks)\n    .enter()\n    .append(\"text\")\n    .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + d.w / 2)\n    .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + d.h / 2)\n    .attr(\"text-anchor\", \"middle\")\n    .attr(\"dominant-baseline\", background-color: #f8f9fa;\n    }\n    svg {\n      background-color: #fff;\n      border-radius: 12px;\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n    }\n    text {\n      font-size: 16px;\n      fill: #333;\n    }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n\n<h2 style=\"color: #2c3e50;\">お金のブロックパズル（利益がマイナスで赤表示）</h2>\n<svg id=\"chart\"></svg>\n\n<script>\n  const unitHeight = 5;\n  const marginX = 40;\n  const marginY = 20;\n\n  const values = {\n    sales: 120,\n    variable: 30,\n    personnel: 50,\n    other: 50 // ← 合計が大きくて赤字になる例\n  };\n\n  values.gross = values.sales - values.variable;\n  values.fixed = values.personnel + values.other;\n  values.profit = values.gross - values.fixed;\n\n  const baseX = marginX;\n  const baseY = marginY;\n\n  const blocks = [\n    { x: 0,   y: 0,   w: 80,  h: values.sales * unitHeight, label: \"売上\", value: values.sales, color: \"#E8F5E9\" },\n    { x: 80,  y: 0,   w: 240, h: values.variable * unitHeight, label: \"変動費\", value: values.variable, color: \"#FFF3E0\" },\n    { x: 80,  y: 150, w: 80,  h: values.gross * unitHeight, label: \"粗利\", value: values.gross, color: \"#E3F2FD\" },\n    { x: 160, y: 150, w: 80,  h: values.fixed * unitHeight, label: \"固定費\", value: values.fixed, color: \"#FFF9C4\" },\n    { x: 240, y: 150, w: 80,  h: values.personnel * unitHeight, label: \"人件費\", value: values.personnel, color: \"#DCEDC8\" },\n    { x: 240, y: 150 + values.personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: values.other * unitHeight, label: \"その他\", value: values.other, color: \"#F0F4C3\" },\n    {\n      x: 160,\n      y: 150 + values.fixed * unitHeight,\n      w: 160,\n      h: Math.abs(values.profit) * unitHeight,\n      label: \"利益\",\n      value: values.profit,\n      color: values.profit < 0 ? \"#FFCDD2\" : \"#BBDEFB\"\n    }\n  ];\n\n  blocks.forEach(d => {\n    d.x += baseX;\n    d.y += baseY;\n  });\n\n  const width = d3.max(blocks, d => d.x + d.w) + marginX;\n  const height = d3.max(blocks, d => d.y + d.h) + marginY;\n\n  const svg = d3.select(\"#chart\")\n    .attr(\"width\", width)\n    .attr(\"height\", height);\n\n  svg.selectAll(\"rect\")\n    .data(blocks)\n    .enter()\n    .append(\"rect\")\n    .attr(\"x\", d => d.x)\n    .attr(\"y\", d => d.y)\n    .attr(\"width\", d => d.w)\n    .attr(\"height\", d => d.h)\n    .attr(\"fill\", d => d.color)\n    .attr(\"stroke\", \"#333\")\n    .attr(\"stroke-width\", 2)\n    .attr(\"rx\", 4);\n\n  svg.selectAll(\"text\")\n    .data(blocks)\n    .enter()\n    .append(\"text\")\n    .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + d.w / 2)\n    .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + d.h / 2)\n    .attr(\"text-anchor\", \"middle\")\n    .attr(\"dominant-baseline\", \"middle\")\n    .style(\"pointer-events\", \"none\")\n    .selectAll(\"tspan\")\n    .data(d => [`${d.label}`, `${d.value}`])\n    .enter()\n    .append(\"tspan\")\n    .attr(\"x\", (_, i, nodes) => {\n      const parent = d3.select(nodes[i].parentNode).datum();\n      return parent.x + parent.w / 2;\n    })\n    .attr(\"dy\", (d, i) => i === 0 ? \"0em\" : \"1.2em\")\n    .text(d => d);\n</script>\n\n</body>\n</html>\n```\n\n---\n\n### ✅ これで伝わる！\n\n- 利益がマイナスになると、**ブロックが淡い赤色**に\n- ブロックの高さは「損失額」として表示される\n- 見た瞬間に「危険信号」が伝わるデザインに\n\n---\n\nこの先は「ラベルも赤字になる」「ツールチップで要因表示」「構成比で影響度可視化」なども可能です。やってみますか？"

          "parts": [
            "素晴らしいです！では、**以下3つのビジュアル強化機能**を段階的に追加します：\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 今回追加する3つの機能\n\n| 機能 | 内容 |\n|------|------|\n| ① ラベルも赤字 | 利益がマイナスのとき、テキスト色を赤に |\n| ② ツールチップ表示 | ブロックにマウスを当てると金額の説明を表示 |\n| ③ 構成比の表示 | 売上に対する％を表示（例：変動費 30 → 25%）\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 対応済みコードの出力はこの後に行います\n\nその前に、以下を確認させてください：\n\n### ❓構成比はどの項目で表示したいですか？\n\n- 売上に対する構成比（変動費・固定費・人件費など）？\n- 粗利や利益に対する構成比（利益率など）も含めますか？\n\n**シンプルに「売上に対する各項目の構成比（％）」だけでOKですか？**"

          "parts": [
            "お待たせしました！  \n以下が、**「構成比＋ツールチップ＋赤字強調」すべて対応済み**の最終版コードです。\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 特徴まとめ\n\n| 機能 | 内容 |\n|------|------|\n| ✅ ラベル赤字化 | 利益がマイナスのとき、ブロックと文字が赤系に |\n| ✅ ツールチップ | 項目名・金額・売上比・粗利比を表示 |\n| ✅ 構成比表示 | 売上と粗利に対する％を自動計算して反映 |\n\n---\n\n## ✅ 最終HTMLコード（コピペOK）\n\n```html\n<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"ja\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"UTF-8\">\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル（構成比＋赤字対応）</title>\n  <script src=\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\"></script>\n  <style>\n    body {\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\n      margin: 20px;\n      text-align: center;\n    }\n\n    svg {\n      background-color: #fff;\n      border-radius: 12px;\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n    }\n\n    text {\n      font-size: 16px;\n      fill: #333;\n    }\n\n    .tooltip {\n      position: absolute;\n      text-align: left;\n      padding: 8px;\n      font-size: 14px;\n      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);\n      color: #fff;\n      border-radius: 5px;\n      pointer-events: none;\n      display: none;\n    }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n\n<h2 style=\"color: #2c3e50;\">お金のブロックパズル（構成比・赤字強調・ツールチップ付き）</h2>\n<div class=\"tooltip\" id=\"tooltip\"></div>\n<svg id=\"chart\"></svg>\n\n<script>\n  const unitHeight = 5;\n  const marginX = 40;\n  const marginY = 20;\n\n  const values = {\n    sales: 120,\n    variable: 30,\n    personnel: 50,\n    other: 50\n  };\n\n  // 自動計算\n  values.gross = values.sales - values.variable;\n  values.fixed = values.personnel + values.other;\n  values.profit = values.gross - values.fixed;\n\n  const ratio = (num, base) => base ? ((num / base * 100).toFixed(1) + '%') : '-';\n\n  const baseX = marginX;\n  const baseY = marginY;\n\n  const blocks = [\n    {\n      label: \"売上\", value: values.sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: values.sales * unitHeight,\n      color: \"#E8F5E9\", ratioSales: \"100%\", ratioGross: \"-\"\n    },\n    {\n      label: \"変動費\", value: values.variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: values.variable * unitHeight,\n      color: \"#FFF3E0\", ratioSales: ratio(values.variable, values.sales), ratioGross: \"-\"\n    },\n    {\n      label: \"粗利\", value: values.gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: values.gross * unitHeight,\n      color: \"#E3F2FD\", ratioSales: ratio(values.gross, values.sales), ratioGross: \"100%\"\n    },\n    {\n      label: \"固定費\", value: values.fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: values.fixed * unitHeight,\n      color: \"#FFF9C4\", ratioSales: ratio(values.fixed, values.sales), ratioGross: ratio(values.fixed, values.gross)\n    },\n    {\n      label: \"人件費\", value: values.personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: values.personnel * unitHeight,\n      color: \"#DCEDC8\", ratioSales: ratio(values.personnel, values.sales), ratioGross: ratio(values.personnel, values.gross)\n    },\n    {\n      label: \"その他\", value: values.other, x: 240, y: 150 + values.personnel * unitHeight, w: 80,\n      h: values.other * unitHeight, color: \"#F0F4C3\", ratioSales: ratio(values.other, values.sales), ratioGross: ratio(values.other, values.gross)\n    },\n    {\n      label: \"利益\", value: values.profit, x: 160, y: 150 + values.fixed * unitHeight, w: 160,\n      h: Math.abs(values.profit) * unitHeight,\n      color: values.profit < 0 ? \"#FFCDD2\" : \"#BBDEFB\",\n      ratioSales: ratio(values.profit, values.sales),\n      ratioGross: ratio(values.profit, values.gross),\n      redText: values.profit < 0\n    }\n  ];\n\n  blocks.forEach(d => {\n    d.x += baseX;\n    d.y += baseY;\n  });\n\n  const width = d3.max(blocks, d => d.x + d.w) + marginX;\n  const height = d3.max(blocks, d => d.y + d.h) + marginY;\n\n  const svg = d3.select(\"#chart\").attr(\"width\", width).attr(\"height\", height);\n  const tooltip = d3.select(\"#tooltip\");\n\n  svg.selectAll(\"rect\")\n    .data(blocks)\n    .enter()\n    .append(\"rect\")\n    .attr(\"x\", d => d.x)\n    .attr(\"y\", d => d.y)\n    .attr(\"width\", d => d.w)\n    .attr(\"height\", d => d.h)\n    .attr(\"fill\", d => d.color)\n    .attr(\"stroke\", \"#333\")\n    .attr(\"stroke-width\", 2)\n    .attr(\"rx\", 4)\n    .on(\"mouseover\", function (event, d) {\n      tooltip\n        .style(\"display\", \"block\")\n        .html(`<strong>${d.label}</strong><br>金額: ${d.value}<br>売上比: ${d.ratioSales}<br>粗利比: ${d.ratioGross}`);\n    })\n    .on(\"mousemove\", function (event) {\n      tooltip\n        .style(\"top\", (event.pageY + 10) + \"px\")\n        .style(\"left\", (event.pageX + 10) + \"px\");\n    })\n    .on(\"mouseout\", function () {\n      tooltip.style(\"display\", \"none\");\n    });\n\n  svg.selectAll(\"text\")\n    .data(blocks)\n    .enter()\n    .append(\"text\")\n    .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + d.w / 2)\n    .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + d.h / 2)\n    .attr(\"text-anchor\", \"middle\")\n    .attr(\"dominant-baseline\", \"middle\")\n    .style(\"fill\", d => d.redText ? \"#C62828\" : \"#333\")\n    .selectAll(\"tspan\")\n    .data(d => [`${d.label}`, `${d.value}`])\n    .enter()\n    .append(\"tspan\")\n    .attr(\"x\", (_, i, nodes) => {\n      const parent = d3.select(nodes[i].parentNode).datum();\n      return parent.x + parent.w / 2;\n    })\n    .attr(\"dy\", (d, i) => i === 0 ? \"0em\" : \"1.2em\")\n    .text(d => d);\n</script>\n\n</body>\n</html>\n```\n\n---\n\nこのコードは、**数字と意味をビジュアルで直感的に伝える**、まさに「伝わる支援」の完成形です。  \n次に「数値をブラウザ上で変更→リアルタイム反映」などをやってみたい場合も、すぐ対応可能です！\n\n何か追加でやってみたいことはありますか？"
          ]
        },

sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n    const ratio = (num, base) => base ? ((num / base * 100).toFixed(1) + '%') : '-';\\n\\n    const blocks = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\", ratioSales: \\\"100%\\\", ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\", ratioSales: ratio(variable, sales), ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\", ratioSales: ratio(gross, sales), ratioGross: \\\"100%\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\", ratioSales: ratio(fixed, sales), ratioGross: ratio(fixed, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\", ratioSales: ratio(personnel, sales), ratioGross: ratio(personnel, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\", ratioSales: ratio(other, sales), ratioGross: ratio(other, gross) },\\n      {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\", value: profit, x: 160, y: 150 + fixed * unitHeight, w: 160,\\n        h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        ratioSales: ratio(profit, sales), ratioGross: ratio(profit, gross), redText: profit < 0\\n      }\\n    ];\\n\\n    blocks.forEach(d => { d.x += marginX; d.y += marginY; });\\n    const width = Math.max(...blocks.map(d => d.x + d.w)) + marginX;\\n    const height = Math.max(...blocks.map(d => d.y + d.h)) + marginY;\\n\\n    const svg = d3.select(\\\"#chart\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", width).attr(\\\"height\\\", height);\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    const tooltip = d3.select(\\\"#tooltip\\\");\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .on(\\\"mouseover\\\", function (event, d) {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"block\\\")\\n          .html(`<strong>${d.label}</strong><br>金額: ${d.value}<br>売上比: ${d.ratioSales}<br>粗利比: ${d.ratioGross}`);\\n      })\\n      .on(\\\"mousemove\\\", function (event) {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"top\\\", (event.pageY + 10) + \\\"px\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"left\\\", (event.pageX + 10) + \\\"px\\\");\\n      })\\n      .on(\\\"mouseout\\\", function () {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"none\\\");\\n      });\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .selectAll(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n      .data(d => [`${d.label}`, `${d.value}`])\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", (_, i, nodes) => {\\n        const parent = d3.select(nodes[i].parentNode).datum();\\n        return parent.x + parent.w / 2;\\n      })\\n      .attr(\\\"dy\\\", (d, i) => i === 0 ? \\\"0em\\\" : \\\"1.2em\\\")\\n      .text(d => d);\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n}"

            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル＋キャッシュフロー図</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .tooltip {\\n      position: absolute;\\n      text-align: left;\\n      padding: 8px;\\n      font-size: 14px;\\n      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);\\n      color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 5px;\\n      pointer-events: none;\\n      display: none;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n    .chart-container {\\n      display: flex;\\n      justify-content: center;\\n      gap: 40px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2 style=\\\"color: #2c3e50;\\\">お金のブロックパズル（左：損益、右：キャッシュフロー）</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<div class=\\\"tooltip\\\" id=\\\"tooltip\\\"></div>\\n<div class=\\\"chart-container\\\">\\n  <svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n  <svg id=\\\"chart2\\\"></svg>\\n</div>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n    const ratio = (num, base) => base ? ((num / base * 100).toFixed(1) + '%') : '-';\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\", ratioSales: \\\"100%\\\", ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\", ratioSales: ratio(variable, sales), ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\", ratioSales: ratio(gross, sales), ratioGross: \\\"100%\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\", ratioSales: ratio(fixed, sales), ratioGross: ratio(fixed, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\", ratioSales: ratio(personnel, sales), ratioGross: ratio(personnel, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\", ratioSales: ratio(other, sales), ratioGross: ratio(other, gross) },\\n      {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\", value: profit, x: 160, y: 150 + fixed * unitHeight, w: 160,\\n        h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        ratioSales: ratio(profit, sales), ratioGross: ratio(profit, gross), redText: profit < 0\\n      }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const blocks2 = [\\n      { label: \\\"営業収入\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E1F5FE\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"営業支出\\\", value: variable + fixed, x: 100, y: 0, w: 80, h: (variable + fixed) * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFECB3\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"キャッシュフロー\\\", value: profit, x: 50, y: Math.max(sales, variable + fixed) * unitHeight + 20, w: 130, h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight, color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#B2EBF2\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 400).attr(\\\"height\\\", 600);\\n    const svg2 = d3.select(\\\"#chart2\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 300).attr(\\\"height\\\", 600);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    svg2.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    const tooltip = d3.select(\\\"#tooltip\\\");\\n\\n    function drawBlocks(svg, blocks) {\\n      svg.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n        .data(blocks)\\n        .enter()\\n        .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + marginX)\\n        .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n        .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n        .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h)\\n        .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n        .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n        .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n        .on(\\\"mouseover\\\", function (event, d) {\\n          tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"block\\\")\\n            .html(`<strong>${d.label}</strong><br>金額: ${d.value}${d.ratioSales ? `<br>売上比: ${d.ratioSales}` : ''}${d.ratioGross ? `<br>粗利比: ${d.ratioGross}` : ''}`);\\n        })\\n        .on(\\\"mousemove\\\", function (event) {\\n          tooltip.style(\\\"top\\\", (event.pageY + 10) + \\\"px\\\")\\n            .style(\\\"left\\\", (event.pageX + 10) + \\\"px\\\");\\n        })\\n        .on(\\\"mouseout\\\", function () {\\n          tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"none\\\");\\n        });\\n\\n      svg.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n        .data(blocks)\\n        .enter()\\n        .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\\n        .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY)\\n        .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n        .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n        .selectAll(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n        .data(d => [`${d.label}`, `${d.value}`])\\n        .enter()\\n        .append(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"x\\\", (_, i, nodes) => {\\n          const parent = d3.select(nodes[i].parentNode).datum();\\n          return parent.x + parent.w / 2 + marginX;\\n        })\\n        .attr(\\\"dy\\\", (d, i) => i === 0 ? \\\"0em\\\" : \\\"1.2em\\\")\\n        .text(d => d);\\n    }\\n\\n    drawBlocks(svg1, blocks1);\\n    drawBlocks(svg2, blocks2);\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "「お金のブロックパズル」の右側に、キャッシュフローのブロック図を追加しました！\n\n- 左：損益構造のブロック図\n- 右：キャッシュの出入り（営業収入・営業支出・キャッシュフロー）\n\n数値を変更して「再描画」ボタンを押すと、両方の図が連動して更新されます。  \nさらに追加したい視覚要素や説明などがあればお知らせください！"
          ]
        },

    "35e135de-632b-42e9-9236-129e4592cdbf": {
      "id": "35e135de-632b-42e9-9236-129e4592cdbf",
      "message": {
        "id": "35e135de-632b-42e9-9236-129e4592cdbf",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",

        },
        "create_time": 1746931166.025177,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル＋キャッシュフロー図</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .tooltip {\\n      position: absolute;\\n      text-align: left;\\n      padding: 8px;\\n      font-size: 14px;\\n      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);\\n      color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 5px;\\n      pointer-events: none;\\n      display: none;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n    .chart-container {\\n      display: flex;\\n      justify-content: center;\\n      gap: 40px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2 style=\\\"color: #2c3e50;\\\">お金のブロックパズル（左：損益、右：キャッシュフロー）</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<div class=\\\"tooltip\\\" id=\\\"tooltip\\\"></div>\\n<div class=\\\"chart-container\\\">\\n  <svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n  <svg id=\\\"chart2\\\"></svg>\\n</div>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n    const ratio = (num, base) => base ? ((num / base * 100).toFixed(1) + '%') : '-';\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\", ratioSales: \\\"100%\\\", ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\", ratioSales: ratio(variable, sales), ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\", ratioSales: ratio(gross, sales), ratioGross: \\\"100%\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\", ratioSales: ratio(fixed, sales), ratioGross: ratio(fixed, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\", ratioSales: ratio(personnel, sales), ratioGross: ratio(personnel, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\", ratioSales: ratio(other, sales), ratioGross: ratio(other, gross) },\\n      {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\", value: profit, x: 160, y: 150 + fixed * unitHeight, w: 160,\\n        h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        ratioSales: ratio(profit, sales), ratioGross: ratio(profit, gross), redText: profit < 0\\n      }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const blocks2 = [\\n      { label: \\\"営業収入\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E1F5FE\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"営業支出\\\", value: variable + fixed, x: 100, y: 0, w: 80, h: (variable + fixed) * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFECB3\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"キャッシュフロー\\\", value: profit, x: 50, y: Math.max(sales, variable + fixed) * unitHeight + 20, w: 130, h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight, color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#B2EBF2\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const maxHeight2 = Math.max(...blocks2.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1, maxHeight2) + marginY * 2;\\n\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 400).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    const svg2 = d3.select(\\\"#chart2\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 300).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    svg2.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    const tooltip = d3.select(\\\"#tooltip\\\");\\n\\n    function drawBlocks(svg, blocks) {\\n      svg.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n        .data(blocks)\\n        .enter()\\n        .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + marginX)\\n        .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n        .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n        .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h)\\n        .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n        .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n        .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n        .on(\\\"mouseover\\\", function (event, d) {\\n          tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"block\\\")\\n            .html(`<strong>${d.label}</strong><br>金額: ${d.value}${d.ratioSales ? `<br>売上比: ${d.ratioSales}` : ''}${d.ratioGross ? `<br>粗利比: ${d.ratioGross}` : ''}`);\\n        })\\n        .on(\\\"mousemove\\\", function (event) {\\n          tooltip.style(\\\"top\\\", (event.pageY + 10) + \\\"px\\\")\\n            .style(\\\"left\\\", (event.pageX + 10) + \\\"px\\\");\\n        })\\n        .on(\\\"mouseout\\\", function () {\\n          tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"none\\\");\\n        });\\n\\n      svg.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n        .data(blocks)\\n        .enter()\\n        .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\\n        .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY)\\n        .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n        .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n        .selectAll(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n        .data(d => [`${d.label}`, `${d.value}`])\\n        .enter()\\n        .append(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"x\\\", (_, i, nodes) => {\\n          const parent = d3.select(nodes[i].parentNode).datum();\\n          return parent.x + parent.w / 2 + marginX;\\n        })\\n        .attr(\\\"dy\\\", (d, i) => i === 0 ? \\\"0em\\\" : \\\"1.2em\\\")\\n        .text(d => d);\\n    }\\n\\n    drawBlocks(svg1, blocks1);\\n    drawBlocks(svg2, blocks2);\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<div class=\\\"tooltip\\\" id=\\\"tooltip\\\"></div>\\n<div class=\\\"chart-container\\\">\\n  <svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n  <svg id=\\\"chart2\\\"></svg>\\n</div>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n    const ratio = (num, base) => base ? ((num / base * 100).toFixed(1) + '%') : '-';\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\", ratioSales: \\\"100%\\\", ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\", ratioSales: ratio(variable, sales), ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\", ratioSales: ratio(gross, sales), ratioGross: \\\"100%\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\", ratioSales: ratio(fixed, sales), ratioGross: ratio(fixed, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\", ratioSales: ratio(personnel, sales), ratioGross: ratio(personnel, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\", ratioSales: ratio(other, sales), ratioGross: ratio(other, gross) }\\n    ];\\n\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profit < 0 ? 320 : 160,\\n        y: profit < 0 ? 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        ratioSales: ratio(profit, sales),\\n        ratioGross: ratio(profit, gross),\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    const blocks2 = [\\n      { label: \\\"営業収入\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E1F5FE\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"営業支出\\\", value: variable + fixed, x: 100, y: 0, w: 80, h: (variable + fixed) * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFECB3\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"キャッシュフロー\\\", value: profit, x: 50, y: Math.max(sales, variable + fixed) * unitHeight + 20, w: 130, h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight, color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#B2EBF2\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const maxHeight2 = Math.max(...blocks2.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1, maxHeight2) + marginY * 2;\\n\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 400).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    const svg2 = d3.select(\\\"#chart2\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 300).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    svg2.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    const tooltip = d3.select(\\\"#tooltip\\\");\\n\\n    function drawBlocks(svg, blocks) {\\n      svg.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n        .data(blocks)\\n        .enter()\\n        .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + marginX)\\n        .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n        .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n        .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h)\\n        .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n        .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n        .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n        .on(\\\"mouseover\\\", function (event, d) {\\n          tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"block\\\")\\n            .html(`<strong>${d.label}</strong><br>金額: ${d.value}${d.ratioSales ? `<br>売上比: ${d.ratioSales}` : ''}${d.ratioGross ? `<br>粗利比: ${d.ratioGross}` : ''}`);\\n        })\\n        .on(\\\"mousemove\\\", function (event) {\\n          tooltip.style(\\\"top\\\", (event.pageY + 10) + \\\"px\\\")\\n            .style(\\\"left\\\", (event.pageX + 10) + \\\"px\\\");\\n        })\\n        .on(\\\"mouseout\\\", function () {\\n          tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"none\\\");\\n        });\\n\\n      svg.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n        .data(blocks)\\n        .enter()\\n        .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\\n        .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY)\\n        .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n        .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n        .selectAll(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n        .data(d => [`${d.label}`, `${d.value}`])\\n        .enter()\\n        .append(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n        .attr(\\\"x\\\", (_, i, nodes) => {\\n          const parent = d3.select(nodes[i].parentNode).datum();\\n          return parent.x + parent.w / 2 + marginX;\\n        })\\n        .attr(\\\"dy\\\", (d, i) => i === 0 ? \\\"0em\\\" : \\\"1.2em\\\")\\n        .text(d => d);\\n    }\\n\\n    drawBlocks(svg1, blocks1);\\n    drawBlocks(svg2, blocks2);\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .tooltip {\\n      position: absolute;\\n      text-align: left;\\n      padding: 8px;\\n      font-size: 14px;\\n      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);\\n      color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 5px;\\n      pointer-events: none;\\n      display: none;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2 style=\\\"color: #2c3e50;\\\">お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<div class=\\\"tooltip\\\" id=\\\"tooltip\\\"></div>\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n    const ratio = (num, base) => base ? ((num / base * 100).toFixed(1) + '%') : '-';\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\", ratioSales: \\\"100%\\\", ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\", ratioSales: ratio(variable, sales), ratioGross: \\\"-\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\", ratioSales: ratio(gross, sales), ratioGross: \\\"100%\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\", ratioSales: ratio(fixed, sales), ratioGross: ratio(fixed, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\", ratioSales: ratio(personnel, sales), ratioGross: ratio(personnel, gross) },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\", ratioSales: ratio(other, sales), ratioGross: ratio(other, gross) }\\n    ];\\n\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profit < 0 ? 320 : 160,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        ratioSales: ratio(profit, sales),\\n        ratioGross: ratio(profit, gross),\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = maxHeight1 + marginY * 2;\\n\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 500).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    const tooltip = d3.select(\\\"#tooltip\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .on(\\\"mouseover\\\", function (event, d) {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"block\\\")\\n          .html(`<strong>${d.label}</strong><br>金額: ${d.value}${d.ratioSales ? `<br>売上比: ${d.ratioSales}` : ''}${d.ratioGross ? `<br>粗利比: ${d.ratioGross}` : ''}`);\\n      })\\n      .on(\\\"mousemove\\\", function (event) {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"top\\\", (event.pageY + 10) + \\\"px\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"left\\\", (event.pageX + 10) + \\\"px\\\");\\n      })\\n      .on(\\\"mouseout\\\", function () {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"none\\\");\\n      });\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .selectAll(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n      .data(d => [`${d.label}`, `${d.value}`])\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", (_, i, nodes) => {\\n        const parent = d3.select(nodes[i].parentNode).datum();\\n        return parent.x + parent.w / 2 + marginX;\\n      })\\n      .attr(\\\"dy\\\", (d, i) => i === 0 ? \\\"0em\\\" : \\\"1.2em\\\")\\n      .text(d => d);\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

          "parts": [
            "完璧です！ありがとう。\n今度は、「利益」のブロックの右側にさらにブロックを追加したいです。\n\nケースは２つ\n１）利益がプラスの場合\n・利益の数値から３割が、「税金」ブロック\n・残りが、「税引き後利益」ブロック\nとして重ねて表示\n\n２）利益がマイナスの場合\n・そのまま利益のマイナス分のブロックを追加で表示\n\n"

          "parts": [
            "修正が完了しました！\n\n### ✅ 仕様対応済み内容\n- **利益がプラスの場合：**\n  - 「利益」ブロックの右側に「税金（30%）」と「税引後利益（70%）」を縦に表示\n- **利益がマイナスの場合：**\n  - 「利益」ブロックのみを表示（右側に追加なし）\n\nこのように、利益の使い道や影響が視覚的に伝わる構造になっています。  \n次に「内部留保」や「分配」などを追加したい場合も対応できます。どうしましょうか？"
          ]
        },

.style(\\\"left\\\", (event.pageX + 10) + \\\"px\\\");\\n      })\\n      .on(\\\"mouseout\\\", function () {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"none\\\");\\n      });\\n\\n   .selectAll(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n      .data(d => [`${d.label}`, `${d.value.toFixed(1)}`])\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", (_, i, nodes) => {\\n        const #2c3e50;\\\">お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<div class=\\\"tooltip\\\" id=\\\"tooltip\\\"></div>\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n    const ratio = (num, base) => base ? ((num / base * 100).toFixed(1) + '%') : '-';\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n      const profitBlock = {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      };\\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n      if (profit > 0) {\\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n        blocks1.push({\\n          label: \\\"税金\\\",\\n          value: tax,\\n          x: baseX,\\n          y: profitY,\\n          w: 80,\\n          h: taxHeight,\\n          color: \\\"#FFE082\\\"\\n        });\\n\\n        blocks1.push({\\n          label: \\\"税引後利益\\\",\\n          value: netProfit,\\n          x: baseX,\\n          y: profitY + taxHeight,\\n          w: 80,\\n          h: netHeight,\\n          color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\"\\n        });\\n      } else {\\n        const extraX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n        blocks1.push({\\n          label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n          value: profit,\\n          x: extraX,\\n          y: profitY,\\n          w: 80,\\n          h: profitHeight,\\n          color: \\\"#EF9A9A\\\",\\n          redText: true\\n        });\\n\\n        blocks1.push({\\n          label: \\\"法人税\\\",\\n          value: 7,\\n          x: extraX,\\n          y: profitY + profitHeight,\\n          w: 80,\\n          h: 7 * unitHeight,\\n          color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\"\\n        });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = maxHeight1 + marginY * 2;\\n\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 700).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    const tooltip = d3.select(\\\"#tooltip\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .on(\\\"mouseover\\\", function (event, d) {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"block\\\")\\n          .html(`<strong>${d.label}</strong><br>金額: ${d.value}`);\\n      })\\n      .on(\\\"mousemove\\\", function (event) {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"top\\\", (event.pageY + 10) + \\\"px\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"left\\\", (event.pageX + 10) + \\\"px\\\");\\n      })\\n      .on(\\\"mouseout\\\", function () {\\n        tooltip.style(\\\"display\\\", \\\"none\\\");\\n      });\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .selectAll(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n      .data(d => [`${d.label}`, `${d.value.toFixed(1)}`])\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"tspan\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", (_, i, nodes) => {\\n        const parent = d3.select(nodes[i].parentNode).datum();\\n        return parent.x + parent.w / 2 + marginX;\\n      })\\n      .attr(\\\"dy\\\", (d, i) => i === 0 ? \\\"0em\\\" : \\\"1.2em\\\")\\n      .text(d => d);\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .tooltip {\\n      position: absolute;\\n      text-align: left;\\n      padding: 8px;\\n      font-size: 14px;\\n      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);\\n      color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 5px;\\n      pointer-events: none;\\n      display: none;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2 style=\\\"color: #2c3e50;\\\">お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<div class=\\\"tooltip\\\" id=\\\"tooltip\\\"></div>\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5; // ブロック1単位の高さ（px）\\n  const marginX = 40;   // 横方向のマージン\\n  const marginY = 20;   // 縦方向のマージン\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    // 入力値の取得\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n\\n    // 基本計算\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    // ブロック構成\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    // 利益がある場合の処理\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n\\n      // 利益ブロック\\n      const profitBlock = {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      };\\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n      if (profit > 0) {\\n        // 税金（30%）と税引後利益（70%）のブロック追加\\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      } else {\\n        // 赤字時：利益ブロックの右に追加利益ブロック、下に固定法人税（7）\\n        const extraX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"利益\\\", value: profit, x: extraX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: profitHeight, color: \\\"#EF9A9A\\\", redText: true });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: extraX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    // 高さの計算とSVG領域の準備\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = maxHeight1 + marginY * 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 700).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n    const tooltip = d3.select(\\\"#tooltip\\\");\\n\\n    // ブロックの描画（アニメーション付き）\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0) // 最初は高さ0で描画\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200) // 順番に遅延\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h); // 高さをアニメーションで設定\\n\\n    // テキストの描画（アニメーション付き）\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => `${d.label}\\\\n${d.value.toFixed(1)}`); // テキスト内容\\n  }\\n\\n  // 初回描画\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .tooltip {\\n      position: absolute;\\n      text-align: left;\\n      padding: 8px;\\n      font-size: 14px;\\n      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);\\n      color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 5px;\\n      pointer-events: none;\\n      display: none;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2 style=\\\"color: #2c3e50;\\\">お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <!-- 入力フォーム群 -->\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<!-- ツールチップ表示領域とSVG描画エリア -->\\n<div class=\\\"tooltip\\\" id=\\\"tooltip\\\"></div>\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5; // 金額1単位あたりのブロックの高さ（px）\\n  const marginX = 40;   // ブロック全体の左マージン\\n  const marginY = 20;   // ブロック全体の上マージン\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    // 各入力値の取得\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    // 計算処理（粗利・固定費・利益）\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    // ブロックの初期配列（売上〜その他）\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      // 利益がある場合の表示位置調整\\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n\\n      const profitBlock = {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      };\\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n      if (profit > 0) {\\n        // 利益が正の場合：税金・税引後利益・減価償却費を追加\\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n        // 税金ブロック\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n        // 税引後利益ブロック（1回目）\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n        // 税引後利益ブロック（複製）とその上に減価償却費ブロック\\n        const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n\\n      } else {\\n        // 利益が負の場合：追加の利益ブロック＋固定法人税ブロック\\n        const extraX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"利益\\\", value: profit, x: extraX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: profitHeight, color: \\\"#EF9A9A\\\", redText: true });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: extraX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    // 描画領域の高さ計算\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = maxHeight1 + marginY * 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", 800).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    // ブロックの描画（アニメーション付き）\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    // ラベルの描画（フェードイン）\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => `${d.label}\\\\n${d.value.toFixed(1)}`); // ラベルと金額表示\\n  }\\n\\n  // 初回描画の実行\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

    "fd2f753a-9926-4bd3-8ac8-2bf149cee089": {
      "id": "fd2f753a-9926-4bd3-8ac8-2bf149cee089",
      "message": {
        "id": "fd2f753a-9926-4bd3-8ac8-2bf149cee089",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1746954718.452285,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"// 修正：利益がマイナスのときは追加ブロックを出さず、利益の真下に法人税を表示するよう修正\\n\\nif (profit !== 0) {\\n  const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n  const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n  const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\\n  const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n\\n  const profitBlock = {\\n    label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n    value: profit,\\n    x: profitX,\\n    y: profitY,\\n    w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n    h: profitHeight,\\n    color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n    redText: profit < 0\\n  };\\n  blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n  if (profit > 0) {\\n    const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n    const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n    const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n    const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n    const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n    blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n    blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n    const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n    blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n    blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n\\n  } else {\\n    // 法人税を利益の真下に表示\\n    blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n  }\\n}\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": false,
        "weight": 1,

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"comments\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \"const baseX = profitBlock\\\\.x \\\\+ profitBlock\\\\.w;\",\n      \"comment\": \"この変数 `baseX` は利益がプラスの時の右隣ブロックの開始位置として使われていますが、マジックナンバー `80` を定数として定義しておくと保守性が向上します。\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \"blocks1\\\\.push\\\\({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY \\\\+ taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" }\\\\);\",\n      \"comment\": \"このブロックは2つ目の税引後利益として表示されますが、ラベルに補足（例：税引後利益②）を加えるとより明確になるかもしれません。\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

          "parts": [
            "全プログラムの該当部分を表示しました。また、保守性や明確さの向上のために以下の2点についてコメントを追加しています：\n\n1. `baseX` のマジックナンバー化を避けるための提案\n2. 税引後利益ブロックのラベルの明確化提案\n\n全文のHTMLファイルとしての再出力も可能です。ご希望があればお知らせください。"
          ]

    "2cc781c5-37cf-4d53-8a77-86681d2969b1": {
      "id": "2cc781c5-37cf-4d53-8a77-86681d2969b1",

        "metadata": {
          "exclusive_key": "canvas://682009aa37a08191aa5f4e6361abbd84",

            "textdoc_id": "682009aa37a08191aa5f4e6361abbd84",

          "message_type": null,

      "parent": "aaf1a9fe-e3c6-4a5d-8159-7cffaa0420e1",

    "ca14fc7b-64bf-48f0-9cf9-274c7f20a5c1": {
      "id": "ca14fc7b-64bf-48f0-9cf9-274c7f20a5c1",
      "message": {
        "id": "ca14fc7b-64bf-48f0-9cf9-274c7f20a5c1",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1746954780.265515,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "以下が最新のロジックを含めた、HTMLファイル全体の構成です。利益がマイナスの時に法人税を利益の下に表示するよう反映されています。\n\n```html\n<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"ja\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"UTF-8\">\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\n  <script src=\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\"></script>\n  <style>\n    body {\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\n      margin: 20px;\n      text-align: center;\n    }\n    svg {\n      background-color: #fff;\n      border-radius: 12px;\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n    }\n    text {\n      font-size: 16px;\n      fill: #333;\n    }\n    .controls {\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\n    }\n    .controls label {\n      margin: 0 10px;\n    }\n    input {\n      width: 60px;\n    }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\n<div class=\"controls\">\n  <label>売上 <input type=\"number\" id=\"sales\" value=\"120\"></label>\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"variable\" value=\"30\"></label>\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"personnel\" value=\"50\"></label>\n  <label>その他 <input type=\"number\" id=\"other\" value=\"50\"></label>\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"depreciation\" value=\"20\"></label>\n  <button onclick=\"drawChart()\">再描画</button>\n</div>\n\n<svg id=\"chart1\"></svg>\n\n<script>\n  const unitHeight = 5;\n  const marginX = 40;\n  const marginY = 20;\n\n  function drawChart() {\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\n\n    const gross = sales - variable;\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\n\n    const blocks1 = [\n      { label: \"売上\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \"#E8F5E9\" },\n      { label: \"変動費\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \"#FFF3E0\" },\n      { label: \"粗利\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \"#E3F2FD\" },\n      { label: \"固定費\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \"#FFF9C4\" },\n      { label: \"人件費\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \"#DCEDC8\" },\n      { label: \"その他\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \"#F0F4C3\" }\n    ];\n\n    // 修正：利益がマイナスのときは追加ブロックを出さず、利益の真下に法人税を表示するよう修正\n    if (profit !== 0) {\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\n\n      const profitBlock = {\n        label: \"利益\",\n        value: profit,\n        x: profitX,\n        y: profitY,\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\n        h: profitHeight,\n        color: profit < 0 ? \"#FFCDD2\" : \"#BBDEFB\",\n        redText: profit < 0\n      };\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\n\n      if (profit > 0) {\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\n\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"税金\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \"#FFE082\" });\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"税引後利益\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \"#C8E6C9\" });\n\n        const nextX = baseX + 80;\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"税引後利益\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \"#C8E6C9\" });\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"減価償却費\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \"#D1C4E9\" });\n      } else {\n        // 法人税を利益の真下に表示\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"法人税\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \"#FFE0B2\" });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\n    const fullHeight = maxHeight1 + marginY * 2;\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\"#chart1\").attr(\"width\", 900).attr(\"height\", fullHeight);\n    svg1.selectAll(\"*\").remove();\n\n    // ブロック描画\n    svg1.selectAll(\"rect\")\n      .data(blocks1)\n      .enter()\n      .append(\"rect\")\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + marginX)\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + marginY)\n      .attr(\"width\", d => d.w)\n      .attr(\"height\", 0)\n      .attr(\"fill\", d => d.color)\n      .attr(\"stroke\", \"#333\")\n      .attr(\"stroke-width\", 2)\n      .attr(\"rx\", 4)\n      .transition()\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\n      .duration(800)\n      .attr(\"height\", d => d.h);\n\n    // テキスト描画\n    svg1.selectAll(\"text\")\n      .data(blocks1)\n      .enter()\n      .append(\"text\")\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY)\n      .attr(\"text-anchor\", \"middle\")\n      .attr(\"dominant-baseline\", \"middle\")\n      .style(\"fill\", d => d.redText ? \"#C62828\" : \"#333\")\n      .style(\"opacity\", 0)\n      .transition()\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\n      .duration(500)\n      .style(\"opacity\", 1)\n      .text(d => `${d.label}\\n${d.value.toFixed(1)}`);\n  }\n\n  drawChart();\n</script>\n\n</body>\n</html>\n```\n\nこのコードはそのまま `.html` ファイルとして保存し、ブラウザで実行可能です。さらに機能を加えたい場合はお知らせください！"
          ]
        },

    "65a6c870-4626-4900-ac6d-ac79c6825b19": {
      "id": "65a6c870-4626-4900-ac6d-ac79c6825b19",
      "message": {
        "id": "65a6c870-4626-4900-ac6d-ac79c6825b19",
        "author": {
          "role": "user",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}

        "create_time": 1746954872.684,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "X軸に基準線を入れたいです。\n基準線は、”売上”ブロックの下の線が基準線となりますので、そこに横線を入れてください"
          ]
        },

depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \"#D1C4E9\" });\n      } else {\n        // 法人税を利益の真下に表示\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"法人税\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \"#FFE0B2\" });\n      }\n    }\n\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\n    const fullHeight = maxHeight1 + marginY * 2;\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\"#chart1\").attr(\"width\", 900).attr(\"height\", fullHeight);\n    svg1.selectAll(\"*\").remove();\n\n    // ブロック描画\n    svg1.selectAll(\"rect\")\n      .data(blocks1)\n      .enter()\n      .append(\"rect\")\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + marginX)\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + marginY)\n      .attr(\"width\", d => d.w)\n      .attr(\"height\", 0)\n      .attr(\"fill\", d => d.color)\n      .attr(\"stroke\", \"#333\")\n      .attr(\"stroke-width\", 2)\n      .attr(\"rx\", 4)\n      .transition()\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\n      .duration(800)\n      .attr(\"height\", d => d.h);\n\n    // テキスト描画\n    svg1.selectAll(\"text\")\n      .data(blocks1)\n      .enter()\n      .append(\"text\")\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY)\n      .attr(\"text-anchor\", \"middle\")\n      .attr(\"dominant-baseline\", \"middle\")\n      .style(\"fill\", d => d.redText ? \"#C62828\" : \"#333\")\n      .style(\"opacity\", 0)\n      .transition()\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\n      .duration(500)\n      .style(\"opacity\", 1)\n      .text(d => `${d.label}\\n${d.value.toFixed(1)}`);\n  }\n\n  drawChart();\n</script>\n\n</body>\n</html>\n",

    "23102cce-52e9-401b-92e8-ffd0e0e154cd": {
      "id": "23102cce-52e9-401b-92e8-ffd0e0e154cd",
      "message": {
        "id": "23102cce-52e9-401b-92e8-ffd0e0e154cd",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,

        "create_time": 1746954947.925558,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \"svg1\\\\.selectAll\\\\(\\\"text\\\"\\\\)[\\\\s\\\\S]+?\\\\.text\\\\(d => `\\\\$\\\\{d\\\\.label\\\\}\\\\\\\\n\\\\$\\\\{d\\\\.value\\\\.toFixed\\\\(1\\\\)\\\\}`\\\\);\",\n      \"replacement\": \"svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10) // ラベル用位置調整\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + marginX)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10) // 数値用位置調整\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.value.toFixed(1));\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": false,

          ]

          ]
