    "11dd8561-e88a-47a0-a868-4302d782e306": {
      "id": "11dd8561-e88a-47a0-a868-4302d782e306",
      "message": {
        "id": "11dd8561-e88a-47a0-a868-4302d782e306",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1746955243.031313,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n\\n      const profitBlock = {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      };\\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n      if (profit > 0) {\\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n        const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n      } else {\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

      "parent": "d9a236b9-38a0-41d6-aa93-b6432059e557",

    "e5e0cc5e-22c9-452f-a5bc-37c940eef99b": {
      "id": "e5e0cc5e-22c9-452f-a5bc-37c940eef99b",
      "message": {
        "id": "e5e0cc5e-22c9-452f-a5bc-37c940eef99b",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1746955273.678464,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ありがとうございます。コードを確認したところ、表示されなくなっている可能性として以下の点が考えられます：\n\n### ❗ 問題点の可能性\n1. **中心寄せのオフセット計算ミス**\n   - `centerOffset` が負の値になる場合、全体の表示位置が画面外にずれて見えなくなる恐れがあります。\n\n2. **`svgWidth` に対して描画領域が大きすぎる**\n   - `blocks1` の `x + w` の合計が画面幅より大きい場合、中心から外れて隠れてしまう可能性があります。\n\n---\n\n### ✅ 修正案\n以下のように `centerOffset` がマイナスにならないように制御を入れるのが効果的です。\n\n```javascript\nconst centerOffset = Math.max((svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2, 0);\n```\n\nこの修正により、中央寄せの計算が安全になり、ブロック群が左にずれて見えなくなる現象が防止されます。\n\n---\n\n### ✍️ 次のステップ\nこの修正を反映した上で、再描画の挙動をご確認いただけますか？  \n必要であれば、コード全体の再生成もいたします。"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": true,
        "weight": 1,

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "以下が修正済みの完全なHTMLコードです。描画が画面内に正しく収まるように中央寄せオフセットに `Math.max(..., 0)` を加え、安全なセンタリングを実現しています。\n\n```javascript\nconst centerOffset = Math.max((svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2, 0);\n```\n\nこれによりブロックが画面外に出てしまうことを防げます。上記の修正はすでに現在のコードに反映されていますので、このまま実行していただければ正しく表示されるはずです。\n\n他にも追加したい表示要素や、アニメーション演出があれば遠慮なくお知らせください。"
          ]
        },

        "content": {

          "parts": [
            "縦軸が長くなった場合に、ブラウザ表示でスクロールが必要になっています。\n縦軸が長くなった場合でも、画面スクロールをせずに、ディスプレイサイズに応じて適切に表示されるように、描画サイズを自動調整するプログラムにしてください"

    "56c1aedc-3c8b-4ec9-9c82-9b8ffa448e78": {
      "id": "56c1aedc-3c8b-4ec9-9c82-9b8ffa448e78",
      "message": {
        "id": "56c1aedc-3c8b-4ec9-9c82-9b8ffa448e78",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1746955439.108634,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ありがとうございます。現在のコードには、`sales`, `variable`, `gross`, `fixed`, `personnel`, `other`, `profit` などが `unitHeight` の計算に使われている一方で、それらの値は `drawChart()` 関数内で定義されています。\n\nところが、`unitHeight` は関数の外（スクリプトの上部）で定義されているため、これらの変数が未定義として扱われてしまい、**JavaScriptのエラーが発生して描画されていない**状況です。\n\n---\n\n### ✅ 修正案\n\n`unitHeight` の計算を `drawChart()` 関数の中に移動する必要があります。以下のように修正します：\n\n```javascript\nfunction drawChart() {\n  const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\n  const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\n  const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\n  const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\n  const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\n\n  const gross = sales - variable;\n  const fixed = personnel + other;\n  const profit = gross - fixed;\n\n  const svgContainerHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.6;\n  const maxBlockValue = Math.max(sales, variable, gross, fixed, personnel, other, profit > 0 ? profit : 0);\n  const unitHeight = svgContainerHeight / (maxBlockValue * 1.5);\n```\n\n---\n\nこの修正を反映した完全なコードに書き直しましょうか？"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": true,
        "weight": 1,

    "3f49cd4b-085b-4b8c-8195-d4cff524cc04": {
      "id": "3f49cd4b-085b-4b8c-8195-d4cff524cc04",
      "message": {
        "id": "3f49cd4b-085b-4b8c-8195-d4cff524cc04",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,

        },
        "create_time": 1746955455.066479,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const svgContainerHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.6;\\n    const maxBlockValue = Math.max(sales, variable, gross, fixed, personnel, other, profit > 0 ? profit : 0);\\n    const unitHeight = svgContainerHeight / (maxBlockValue * 1.5);\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n\\n      const profitBlock = {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      };\\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n      if (profit > 0) {\\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n        const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n      } else {\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = svgContainerHeight;\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = Math.max((svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2, 0);\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY -           ]

            "以下のコードに戻してください\n\n<!DOCTYPE html>\r\n<html lang=\"ja\">\r\n<head>\r\n  <meta charset=\"UTF-8\">\r\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\r\n  <script src=\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\"></script>\r\n  <style>\r\n    body {\r\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\r\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\r\n      margin: 20px;\r\n      text-align: center;\r\n    }\r\n    svg {\r\n      background-color: #fff;\r\n      border-radius: 12px;\r\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\r\n    }\r\n    text {\r\n      font-size: 16px;\r\n      fill: #333;\r\n    }\r\n    .controls {\r\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\r\n    }\r\n    .controls label {\r\n      margin: 0 10px;\r\n    }\r\n    input {\r\n      width: 60px;\r\n    }\r\n  </style>\r\n</head>\r\n<body>\r\n\r\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\r\n<div class=\"controls\">\r\n  <label>売上 <input type=\"number\" id=\"sales\" value=\"120\"></label>\r\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"variable\" value=\"30\"></label>\r\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"personnel\" value=\"50\"></label>\r\n  <label>その他 <input type=\"number\" id=\"other\" value=\"50\"></label>\r\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"depreciation\" value=\"20\"></label>\r\n  <button onclick=\"drawChart()\">再描画</button>\r\n</div>\r\n\r\n<svg id=\"chart1\"></svg>\r\n\r\n<script>\r\n  const unitHeight = 5;\r\n  const marginX = 40;\r\n  const marginY = 20;\r\n\r\n  function drawChart() {\r\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\r\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\r\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\r\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\r\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\r\n\r\n    const gross = sales - variable;\r\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\r\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\r\n\r\n    const blocks1 = [\r\n      { label: \"売上\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \"#E8F5E9\" },\r\n      { label: \"変動費\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \"#FFF3E0\" },\r\n      { label: \"粗利\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \"#E3F2FD\" },\r\n      { label: \"固定費\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \"#FFF9C4\" },\r\n      { label: \"人件費\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \"#DCEDC8\" },\r\n      { label: \"その他\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \"#F0F4C3\" }\r\n    ];\r\n\r\n    if (profit !== 0) {\r\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\r\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\r\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\r\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\r\n\r\n      const profitBlock = {\r\n        label: \"利益\",\r\n        value: profit,\r\n        x: profitX,\r\n        y: profitY,\r\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\r\n        h: profitHeight,\r\n        color: profit < 0 ? \"#FFCDD2\" : \"#BBDEFB\",\r\n        redText: profit < 0\r\n      };\r\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\r\n\r\n      if (profit > 0) {\r\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\r\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\r\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\r\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\r\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\r\n\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"税金\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \"#FFE082\" });\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"税引後利益\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \"#C8E6C9\" });\r\n\r\n        const nextX = baseX + 80;\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"税引後利益\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \"#C8E6C9\" });\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"減価償却費\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \"#D1C4E9\" });\r\n      } else {\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"法人税\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \"#FFE0B2\" });\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\r\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\r\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\r\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\r\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\"#chart1\").attr(\"width\", svgWidth).attr(\"height\", fullHeight);\r\n    svg1.selectAll(\"*\").remove();\r\n\r\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \"売上\");\r\n    svg1.append(\"line\")\r\n      .attr(\"x1\", centerOffset)\r\n      .attr(\"x2\", window.innerWidth - 40)\r\n      .attr(\"y1\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\r\n      .attr(\"y2\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\r\n      .attr(\"stroke\", \"#666\")\r\n      .attr(\"stroke-width\", 2)\r\n      .attr(\"stroke-dasharray\", \"4,2\");\r\n\r\n    svg1.selectAll(\"rect\")\r\n      .data(blocks1)\r\n      .enter()\r\n      .append(\"rect\")\r\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\r\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + marginY)\r\n      .attr(\"width\", d => d.w)\r\n      .attr(\"height\", 0)\r\n      .attr(\"fill\", d => d.color)\r\n      .attr(\"stroke\", \"#333\")\r\n      .attr(\"stroke-width\", 2)\r\n      .attr(\"rx\", 4)\r\n      .transition()\r\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\r\n      .duration(800)\r\n      .attr(\"height\", d => d.h);\r\n\r\n    svg1.selectAll(\"text\")\r\n      .data(blocks1)\r\n      .enter()\r\n      .append(\"text\")\r\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\r\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\r\n      .attr(\"text-anchor\", \"middle\")\r\n      .attr(\"dominant-baseline\", \"middle\")\r\n      .style(\"fill\", d => d.redText ? \"#C62828\" : \"#333\")\r\n      .style(\"opacity\", 0)\r\n      .style(\"font-size\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \"10px\" : d.h < 60 ? \"12px\" : \"14px\"))\r\n      .transition()\r\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\r\n      .duration(500)\r\n      .style(\"opacity\", 1)\r\n      .text(d => d.label);\r\n\r\n    svg1.selectAll(\"text.value\")\r\n      .data(blocks1)\r\n      .enter()\r\n      .append(\"text\")\r\n      .attr(\"class\", \"value\")\r\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\r\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\r\n      .attr(\"text-anchor\", \"middle\")\r\n      .attr(\"dominant-baseline\", \"middle\")\r\n      .style(\"fill\", d => d.redText ? \"#C62828\" : \"#333\")\r\n      .style(\"opacity\", 0)\r\n      .style(\"font-size\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \"10px\" : d.h < 60 ? \"12px\" : \"14px\"))\r\n      .transition()\r\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\r\n      .duration(500)\r\n      .style(\"opacity\", 1)\r\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  drawChart();\r\n</script>\r\n\r\n</body>\r\n</html>\r"

variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n\\n      const profitBlock = {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      };\\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n      if (profit > 0) {\\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n        const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n      } else {\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

    "d121f5ea-8511-49e1-9fab-9903d8727f50": {
      "id": "d121f5ea-8511-49e1-9fab-9903d8727f50",

        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ありがとうございます。コードが動かない原因として、`drawChart()` 関数の中で `unitHeight` を使っているのに、それが関数の外で定義されており、かつ依存する変数（`sales`, `variable`, `personnel`, `other`など）よりも先に定義されてしまっている可能性があります。\n\n---\n\n### ✅ 修正案\n\n以下のように `unitHeight` を `drawChart()` 関数の内部、数値が取得された直後に定義し直します：\n\n```javascript\nfunction drawChart() {\n  const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\n  const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\n  const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\n  const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\n  const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\n\n  const gross = sales - variable;\n  const fixed = personnel + other;\n  const profit = gross - fixed;\n\n  // 最大値に応じて動的に高さスケールを決定\n  const maxBlockValue = Math.max(sales, variable, gross, fixed, personnel + other, profit > 0 ? profit : 0);\n  const unitHeight = (window.innerHeight * 0.6) / (maxBlockValue * 1.5);\n```\n\nこの変更により、`unitHeight` のスコープと依存関係が解消され、描画に必要なスケーリングも適切に行われます。\n\n---\n\n### 次のステップ\n\nご希望であれば、この修正を反映した完全なコードを再生成いたします。再出力しましょうか？"

depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n      } else {\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + offsetY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY -     "3b201ba6-800f-4424-8c0d-948a100b0325": {
      "id": "3b201ba6-800f-4424-8c0d-948a100b0325",
      "message": {
        "id": "3b201ba6-800f-4424-8c0d-948a100b0325",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,

        },
        "create_time": 1747012547.052294,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const offsetY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const maxBlockValue = Math.max(sales, variable, gross, fixed, profit > 0 ? profit : 0);\\n    const unitHeight = (window.innerHeight * 0.6) / (maxBlockValue * 1.5);\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : baseY + fixed * unitHeight;\\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n\\n      const profitBlock = {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      };\\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n      if (profit > 0) {\\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n        const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n      } else {\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + offsetY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ありがとうございます。利益のブロックが表示されない理由として考えられるのは：\n\n- `profit <= 0` の場合、表示ロジックが別処理になっている\n- `profitBlock` の `y`, `h` が適切に設定されていない\n- `profitBlock` 自体は作成されているが、範囲外に配置されている（`y` 座標が画面外）\n\nこの問題を解消するため、利益ブロックが **必ず「固定費・その他」ブロックの下に配置される**ように、座標設定を見直してコードを修正します。利益の正負に関わらず、共通の表示ポジションに統一した形で更新します。少々お待ちください。"
          ]
        },

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "失礼しました。利益の `profitY` 座標はすでに `otherBottomY` に設定されていますが、それでも表示されないのは他の条件、たとえば `profit <= 0` のときの `h`（高さ）が 0 または非常に小さくなること、あるいは `w` や `x` の位置がズレている可能性があります。\n\n次の修正案では、**利益ブロックを常に otherBottomY に表示**し、`x` を明確に定義して描画を保証するよう調整します。これにより、マイナス利益も含めてブロックが必ず画面上に表示されます。コードを再構成してよろしいでしょうか？"
          ]

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const offsetY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const maxBlockValue = Math.max(sales, variable, gross, fixed, profit > 0 ? profit : 0);\\n    const unitHeight = (window.innerHeight * 0.6) / (maxBlockValue * 1.5);\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: 160,\\n      y: otherBottomY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + offsetY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY -             "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const offsetY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const maxBlockValue = Math.max(sales, variable, gross, fixed, profit > 0 ? profit : 0);\\n    const unitHeight = (window.innerHeight * 0.6) / (maxBlockValue * 1.5);\\n\\n    // 定義済み位置のルールをまとめる\\n    const positions = {\\n      sales: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 80 },\\n      variable: { x: 80, y: 0, w: 240 },\\n      baseY: variable * unitHeight,\\n      gross: { x: 80 },\\n      fixed: { x: 160 },\\n      personnel: { x: 240 },\\n      other: { x: 240 },\\n      profit: { x: 160 },\\n      taxStartX: 320,\\n      taxStep: 80\\n    };\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: positions.sales.x, y: positions.sales.y, w: positions.sales.w, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: positions.variable.x, y: positions.variable.y, w: positions.variable.w, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: positions.gross.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: positions.fixed.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: positions.personnel.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: positions.other.x, y: positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: positions.profit.x,\\n      y: otherBottomY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = positions.taxStartX + positions.taxStep;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + offsetY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n         "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ありがとうございます。描画サイズが縦幅の90%になっていない理由として、`unitHeight` が固定値に基づいて計算されており、その結果 `block.y + block.h` が `fullHeight` を超えてしまっている可能性があります。\n\n### ✅ 解決策：\n1. **`fullHeight` を先に 90% に設定**\n2. **`unitHeight` を `fullHeight` に収まるように動的計算**（これが重要）\n\nこれにより、どんな値でもブロック全体がディスプレイ内に収まるようになります。\n\nこの修正を全体コードに適用します。少々お待ちください。"
          ]
        },

        "end_turn": true,
        "weight": 1,

    "28d02a59-4572-4a18-b9fa-bf38f4f0f5a3": {
      "id": "28d02a59-4572-4a18-b9fa-bf38f4f0f5a3",
      "message": {
        "id": "28d02a59-4572-4a18-b9fa-bf38f4f0f5a3",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747013067.693765,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const offsetY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const maxBlockValue = sales + depreciation + (profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 : 7);\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - offsetY * 2) / maxBlockValue;\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const positions = {\\n      sales: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 80 },\\n      variable: { x: 80, y: 0, w: 240 },\\n      baseY: baseY,\\n      gross: { x: 80 },\\n      fixed: { x: 160 },\\n      personnel: { x: 240 },\\n      other: { x: 240 },\\n      profit: { x: 160 },\\n      taxStartX: 320,\\n      taxStep: 80\\n    };\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: positions.sales.x, y: positions.sales.y, w: positions.sales.w, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: positions.variable.x, y: positions.variable.y, w: positions.variable.w, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: positions.gross.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: positions.fixed.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: positions.personnel.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: positions.other.x, y: positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: positions.profit.x,\\n      y: otherBottomY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = positions.taxStartX + positions.taxStep;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const totalBlockValue =\\n      sales +\\n      variable +\\n      gross +\\n      fixed +\\n      Math.abs(profit) +\\n      (profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 + (profit - profit * 0.3) + depreciation : 7);\\n\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - offsetY * 2) / totalBlockValue;\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const positions = {\\n      sales: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 80 },\\n      variable: { x: 80, y: 0, w: 240 },\\n      baseY: baseY,\\n      gross: { x: 80 },\\n      fixed: { x: 160 },\\n      personnel: { x: 240 },\\n      other: { x: 240 },\\n      profit: { x: 160 },\\n      taxStartX: 320,\\n      taxStep: 80\\n    };\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: positions.sales.x, y: positions.sales.y, w: positions.sales.w, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: positions.variable.x, y: positions.variable.y, w: positions.variable.w, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: positions.gross.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: positions.fixed.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: positions.personnel.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: positions.other.x, y: positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: positions.profit.x,\\n      y: otherBottomY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = positions.taxStartX + positions.taxStep;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

    "9aca7812-9173-4ca6-8117-888c1ea59c55": {
      "id": "9aca7812-9173-4ca6-8117-888c1ea59c55",
      "message": {

        "create_time": 1747013305.206222,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "コード全体を見直し、「減価償却費」などの数値が大きくなってもすべてのブロックが描画範囲に収まるよう `unitHeight` の計算と `totalBlockValue` の見積もりロジックを最適化しました。表示をご確認いただけますか？"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": true,
        "weight": 1,
        "metadata": {
          "finish_details": {
            "type": "stop",

              200002
            ]
          },

          "gizmo_id": "g-6812eea79c908191912f8d290fd34245",
          "message_type": null,
          "model_slug": "gpt-4o",
          "default_model_slug": "gpt-4o",
          "parent_id": "66a7ff89-a5bf-4fdb-8cc8-df6c3ddf3fc5",
          "request_id": "93e6229f3a8c7eef-KIX",
          "timestamp_": "absolute"
        },
        "recipient": "all",
        "channel": null
      },
      "parent": "66a7ff89-a5bf-4fdb-8cc8-df6c3ddf3fc5",

    "530c6f50-b122-41e5-a872-f6756156fc13": {
      "id": "530c6f50-b122-41e5-a872-f6756156fc13",
      "message": {
        "id": "530c6f50-b122-41e5-a872-f6756156fc13",
        "author": {
          "role": "user",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747013453.127345,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "できていないですね。\n\n例えば、減価償却費が300となると、売上120に対して、上部に大きくはみ出します。\n\nその場合、全体の表示を下に下げて、減価償却費の上部まで適切に表示されるよう、表示の位置を調整してください"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": null,
        "weight": 1,
        "metadata": {
          "dictation": false,
          "request_id": "93e627443f687eef-KIX",
          "message_source": null,
          "timestamp_": "absolute",
          "message_type": null
        },
        "recipient": "all",
        "channel": null

      "parent": "9aca7812-9173-4ca6-8117-888c1ea59c55",
      "children": [
        "8b1a0a23-c970-4a60-b538-e3b57949aae7"
      ]
    },
    "8b1a0a23-c970-4a60-b538-e3b57949aae7": {
      "id": "8b1a0a23-c970-4a60-b538-e3b57949aae7",
      "message": {
        "id": "8b1a0a23-c970-4a60-b538-e3b57949aae7",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747013454.154042,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ありがとうございます。ご指摘の通り、減価償却費が大きい場合に上に飛び出してしまうのは、減価償却費ブロックが “Y座標を基準にして上方向へ伸びる” 特性があるからです。\n\n### ✅ 解決方針：\n1. 減価償却費など「上に伸びる」ブロックの最上部Y座標を計算\n2. そのY位置に合わせて、全体の `offsetY` を**下方向に移動**させる（つまり、全体表示を下げる）\n3. `unitHeight` の計算もこの余白を含めて最適化する\n\nこの修正により、どんなに大きな数値を入れても全体が見切れず、画面内に収まるようになります。  \nそれでは、上記の内容をもとにコード全体を修正します。少々お待ちください。"
          ]
        },

variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const totalHeightBlocks =\\n      variable +\\n      gross +\\n      fixed +\\n      Math.abs(profit) +\\n      (profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 + (profit -
