sales * unitHeight, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: offsetY - variable * unitHeight, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: 160,\\n      y: otherBottomY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = 400;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const offsetY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const totalBlockValue =\\n      sales + depreciation + (profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 : 7);\\n\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - offsetY * 2) / totalBlockValue;\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const positions = {\\n      sales: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 80 },\\n      variable: { x: 80, y: 0, w: 240 },\\n      baseY: baseY,\\n      gross: { x: 80 },\\n      fixed: { x: 160 },\\n      personnel: { x: 240 },\\n      other: { x: 240 },\\n      profit: { x: 160 },\\n      taxStartX: 320,\\n      taxStep: 80\\n    };\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: positions.sales.x, y: positions.sales.y, w: positions.sales.w, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: positions.variable.x, y: positions.variable.y, w: positions.variable.w, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: positions.gross.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: positions.fixed.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: positions.personnel.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: positions.other.x, y: positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: positions.profit.x,\\n      y: otherBottomY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = positions.taxStartX + positions.taxStep;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]

    "40b078df-6228-426e-ae94-de96c661f946": {
      "id": "40b078df-6228-426e-ae94-de96c661f946",
      "message": {
        "id": "40b078df-6228-426e-ae94-de96c661f946",

        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "やはり、減価償却費の数値が大きい場合は、ブロックの上部が消えてしまいますね。"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": null,
        "weight": 1,
        "metadata": {

          "request_id": "93e62bd7c93e7eef-KIX",

    "f6307176-a2f6-4dbd-99f4-6d4897032f75": {
      "id": "f6307176-a2f6-4dbd-99f4-6d4897032f75",
      "message": {
        "id": "f6307176-a2f6-4dbd-99f4-6d4897032f75",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747013641.74388,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "はい、現状のコードでは「減価償却費」が上方向に伸びるレイアウトであるため、ブロックの上端が `svg` の表示範囲外に出てしまうケースが発生します。\n\n### ✅ 今回の対応方針\n- **全ブロックの最上端と最下端を計算**し、その範囲に合わせて `unitHeight` を調整\n- **`offsetY` も動的に再計算**して、すべてのブロックが上下中央に収まるようにする\n\nこれにより、たとえば減価償却費に「300」など大きな数値を入力しても、全体が見切れることなく画面内に表示されます。\n\nすぐにこの調整をコードに反映します。少々お待ちください。"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": true,
        "weight": 1,
        "metadata": {
          "finish_details": {

            ]

          "parent_id": "40b078df-6228-426e-ae94-de96c661f946",

      "parent": "40b078df-6228-426e-ae94-de96c661f946",

    "a5438779-9618-4ff3-a865-378a3ae921f5": {
      "id": "a5438779-9618-4ff3-a865-378a3ae921f5",
      "message": {
        "id": "a5438779-9618-4ff3-a865-378a3ae921f5",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747013712.066025,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const minMargin = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const baseBlockY = variable;\\n    const baseBlockBottom = baseBlockY + gross + fixed + Math.abs(profit);\\n    const depreciationTop = profit > 0 ? baseBlockBottom + profit * 0.3 - depreciation : baseBlockBottom;\\n    const totalHeight = Math.max(baseBlockBottom, depreciationTop + depreciation);\\n\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - minMargin * 2) / totalHeight;\\n    const offsetY = fullHeight - unitHeight * baseBlockBottom;\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight + offsetY;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: offsetY - sales * unitHeight, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: offsetY - variable * unitHeight, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: 160,\\n      y: otherBottomY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = 400;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

        "end_turn": false,

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const offsetY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const totalBlockValue =\\n      sales + depreciation + (profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 : 7);\\n\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - offsetY * 2) / totalBlockValue;\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const positions = {\\n      sales: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 80 },\\n      variable: { x: 80, y: 0, w: 240 },\\n      baseY: baseY,\\n      gross: { x: 80 },\\n      fixed: { x: 160 },\\n      personnel: { x: 240 },\\n      other: { x: 240 },\\n      profit: { x: 160 },\\n      taxStartX: 320,\\n      taxStep: 80\\n    };\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: positions.sales.x, y: positions.sales.y, w: positions.sales.w, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: positions.variable.x, y: positions.variable.y, w: positions.variable.w, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: positions.gross.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: positions.fixed.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: positions.personnel.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: positions.other.x, y: positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: positions.profit.x,\\n      y: otherBottomY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = positions.taxStartX + positions.taxStep;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

    "10a2a61a-4aa9-4351-b581-b1e0b2d17e42": {
      "id": "10a2a61a-4aa9-4351-b581-b1e0b2d17e42",
      "message": {
        "id": "10a2a61a-4aa9-4351-b581-b1e0b2d17e42",

        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "一旦、このブロックパズルの表示の考え方を示します。\n\n売上のブロックの底辺が座標の０基準となります。\n利益がプラスの場合は、利益の底辺も０基準に揃う\n利益がマイナスの場合は、０基準よりも固定費・その他のブロックがマイナス分下にはみ出る"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": null,
        "weight": 1,
        "metadata": {
          "dictation": false,
          "request_id": "93e6330d8ef67eef-KIX",
          "message_source": null,
          "timestamp_": "absolute",
          "message_type": null
        },
        "recipient": "all",
        "channel": null
      },
      "parent": "f1fd89cc-7ca2-4b44-8f4d-3b5101641ce7",
      "children": [
        "a7484260-da3f-4b76-8f76-c58168392b0b"
      ]
    },
    "a7484260-da3f-4b76-8f76-c58168392b0b": {
      "id": "a7484260-da3f-4b76-8f76-c58168392b0b",
      "message": {
        "id": "a7484260-da3f-4b76-8f76-c58168392b0b",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747013938.582239,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "とても大事な視点をありがとうございます。  \nこの「0基準（売上の底辺）」を軸にするレイアウト方針、非常に整理されており、以下のようにまとめ直せます：\n\n---\n\n### ✅ ブロック表示の基準ルール（改訂版）\n\n| 要素 | 表示位置のルール |\n|------|------------------|\n| **売上** | ブロックの「底辺」が**Y=0基準**になる（画面下部からの距離） |\n| **変動費** | 売上の上に積み上がらず、「売上ブロックの上」にY座標0から描画される（描画上部に表示） |\n| **粗利・固定費・人件費・その他** | Y=0基準より上方向（つまり上に積む） |\n| **利益がプラス** | 利益ブロックの**底辺がY=0基準に揃う**（固定費ブロックと上に積む構成） |\n| **利益がマイナス** | 固定費・その他ブロックが**Y=0基準より下に突き出る構成**（利益が損失のため） |\n\n---\n\nこの構成は、視覚的に「儲けているか／赤字になっているか」が一目で分かる構成になりますね。\n\n### ✏️ 今後の対応方針\n- Y=0を画面中央や下端に設定\n- 各ブロックのY座標を「売上の底辺＝0」に揃える\n- マイナス利益時は、他ブロックの表示も座標をマイナス方向に調整\n\n---\n\n次にこのロジックを反映したコードに調整していく準備が整っています。  \nよろしければ、具体的な「売上」や「利益」などの例をもとに反映させていきましょうか？"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": true,
        "weight": 1,

variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const tax = profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 : 7;\\n    const netProfit = profit > 0 ? profit - tax : 0;\\n    const maxHeight = sales + (profit > 0 ? gross + fixed + profit + tax + netProfit + depreciation : gross + fixed + Math.abs(profit) + tax);\\n\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - svgPadding * 2) / maxHeight;\\n    const svgHeight = fullHeight;\\n    const baseY = svgHeight - sales * unitHeight - svgPadding;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: baseY + (sales - sales) * unitHeight, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: baseY + (sales - variable) * unitHeight, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY - gross * unitHeight, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY - gross * unitHeight, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY - gross * unitHeight, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY - gross * unitHeight + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const profitY = baseY - gross * unitHeight + fixed * unitHeight;\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: 160,\\n        y: profit > 0 ? profitY - profit * unitHeight : profitY,\\n        w: 160,\\n        h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      });\\n\\n      if (profit > 0) {\\n        const taxY = profitY - profit * unitHeight;\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: 320, y: taxY, w: 80, h: tax * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: 320, y: taxY + tax * unitHeight, w: 80, h: netProfit * unitHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n        const nextX = 400;\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: taxY + tax * unitHeight, w: 80, h: netProfit * unitHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: taxY + tax * unitHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n      } else {\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitY + Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", svgHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ブロックパズルの表示ロジックを「売上の底辺＝Y=0基準」として再構成しました。  \n利益がプラスのときは0基準に揃い、マイナス時はその分だけブロック群が下に突き出るようになっています。\n\nブラウザで確認のうえ、ご希望の見え方に合っているか教えてください。"
          ]

            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const offsetY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const totalBlockValue =\\n      sales + depreciation + (profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 : 7);\\n\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - offsetY * 2) / totalBlockValue;\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const positions = {\\n      sales: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 80 },\\n      variable: { x: 80, y: 0, w: 240 },\\n      baseY: baseY,\\n      gross: { x: 80 },\\n      fixed: { x: 160 },\\n      personnel: { x: 240 },\\n      other: { x: 240 },\\n      profit: { x: 160 },\\n      taxStartX: 320,\\n      taxStep: 80\\n    };\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: positions.sales.x, y: positions.sales.y, w: positions.sales.w, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: positions.variable.x, y: positions.variable.y, w: positions.variable.w, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: positions.gross.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: positions.fixed.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: positions.personnel.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: positions.other.x, y: positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: positions.profit.x,\\n      y: otherBottomY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = positions.taxStartX + positions.taxStep;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlock.y + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + offsetY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + offsetY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "安定版のコードに戻しました。今後この状態を基準に変更を加えていくことが可能です。次に進めたい内容があれば教えてください。"
          ]

      "id": "d6e42c8c-621a-4528-a72d-cc744a1d4c19",
      "message": {
        "id": "d6e42c8c-621a-4528-a72d-cc744a1d4c19",

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "売上ブロックの底辺がY軸の０基準となります。\n高さとしては、売上の数値か、減価償却費と税引後利益を足した数値がプラス軸としての表示幅となります。\n\nですので、これらの数値が確定後に、全体のブロックが適切に表示されるように、表示位置を決定するコードに修正してください"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": null,
        "weight": 1,
        "metadata": {

    "43dccfbb-b8b2-4da1-b03e-cbed6f660deb": {
      "id": "43dccfbb-b8b2-4da1-b03e-cbed6f660deb",

        "id": "43dccfbb-b8b2-4da1-b03e-cbed6f660deb",

        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const offsetY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const tax = profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 : 7;\\n    const netProfit = profit > 0 ? profit - tax : 0;\\n    const extendedTop = profit > 0 ? tax + netProfit + depreciation : 7;\\n    const topValue = Math.max(sales, extendedTop);\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - offsetY * 2) / (sales + extendedTop);\\n    const zeroY = fullHeight - topValue * unitHeight - offsetY;\\n\\n    const positions = {\\n      sales: { x: 0, y: zeroY + (topValue - sales) * unitHeight, w: 80 },\\n      variable: { x: 80, y: zeroY + (topValue - variable) * unitHeight, w: 240 },\\n      gross: { x: 80 },\\n      fixed: { x: 160 },\\n      personnel: { x: 240 },\\n      other: { x: 240 },\\n      profit: { x: 160 },\\n      taxStartX: 320,\\n      taxStep: 80\\n    };\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: positions.sales.x, y: positions.sales.y, w: positions.sales.w, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: positions.variable.x, y: positions.variable.y, w: positions.variable.w, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: positions.gross.x, y: zeroY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: positions.fixed.x, y: zeroY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: positions.personnel.x, y: zeroY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: positions.other.x, y: zeroY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const profitBlockY = zeroY + fixed * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: positions.profit.x,\\n      y: profitBlockY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlockY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlockY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = positions.taxStartX + positions.taxStep;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlockY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlockY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlockY + profitBlock.h, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

          ]

        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": null,
        "weight": 1,
        "metadata": {
          "dictation": false,
          "request_id": "93e63db2fe63e139-KIX",

    "adbf50d0-553d-47c5-aedb-4f072e34a398": {
      "id": "adbf50d0-553d-47c5-aedb-4f072e34a398",
      "message": {
        "id": "adbf50d0-553d-47c5-aedb-4f072e34a398",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747014373.014618,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ありがとうございます。ご指摘の通り、「変動費」は売上と並列ではなく、**売上ブロックの上部に接するように表示**されるべきです。\n\nつまり、次のように表示されるべきです：\n\n- 売上：下から積み上げる基準ブロック\n- 変動費：売上と同じX位置だが、**売上の上に重なるように配置**\n\n### ✅ 修正ポイント\n現在：\n```js\n{ label: \"変動費\", x: 80, y: zeroY + (topValue - variable) * unitHeight, ... }\n```\n→ この計算では「売上の上に接する」になっていません。\n\n修正案：\n```js\nconst salesY = zeroY + (topValue - sales) * unitHeight;\n{ label: \"変動費\", x: 80, y: salesY - variable * unitHeight, ... }\n```\n\nこのように修正することで、変動費が売上の上にぴったり重なるようになります。\n\nすぐに修正を反映しますね。"
          ]
        },

40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 -         "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ご指摘ありがとうございます。「売上の底辺が0基準」というルールに基づくと、すべてのブロックのY座標は**売上の高さ（pixel）を基準にして上下に配置**する必要があります。\n\n### ✅ 正しい0基準の考え方（Y=0が売上の底辺）：\n\n- **売上**：`Y = 0`（底辺が基準）\n- **変動費**：`Y = -変動費の高さ`\n- **粗利・固定費・人件費・その他**：`Y = +0`から積み上げる\n- **利益（プラス）**：`Y = 固定費などの合計高さ`\n- **利益（マイナス）**：`Y = 0 - 損失の高さ`（下にはみ出す）\n\n### 🎯 修正方針\n\nSVGの中心より少し下に「売上の底辺（Y=0）」を置き、他のブロックの `y` 座標をすべてそれに対してプラス・マイナスに調整します。\n\n---\n\nこのルールに沿って、全体を描画し直すようコードを整理し、再修正いたします。少々お待ちください。"
          ]
        },

Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: 320, y: profitBlockY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: 320, y: profitBlockY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      const nextX = 400;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlockY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlockY + taxHeight -     "90f45f45-1858-422d-a20b-04452ac7eda7": {
      "id": "90f45f45-1858-422d-a20b-04452ac7eda7",
      "message": {
        "id": "90f45f45-1858-422d-a20b-04452ac7eda7",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747014499.59456,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n    const tax = profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 : 7;\\n    const netProfit = profit > 0 ? profit - tax : 0;\\n\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const topBlock = Math.max(variable, gross + fixed + (profit > 0 ? profit + tax + netProfit + depreciation : 0));\\n    const totalHeight = sales + topBlock + (profit < 0 ? Math.abs(profit) : 0);\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - 40) / totalHeight;\\n    const zeroY = topBlock * unitHeight + 20;\\n\\n    const blocks = [];\\n\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: zeroY - sales * unitHeight, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: zeroY - sales * unitHeight - variable * unitHeight, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: zeroY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: zeroY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: zeroY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: zeroY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" });\\n\\n    const profitBlockY = profit >= 0 ? zeroY + fixed * unitHeight : zeroY - Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    blocks.push({\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: 160,\\n      y: profitBlockY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    });\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const taxY = profitBlockY;\\n      const netY = taxY + taxHeight;\\n      const nextX = 400;\\n\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: 320, y: taxY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: 320, y: netY, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: netY, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: netY - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlockY + Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svg = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const centerOffset = (window.innerWidth - 40 - Math.max(...blocks.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const offsetX = 40;\\n  const offsetY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const tax = profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 : 7;\\n    const netProfit = profit > 0 ? profit - tax : 0;\\n    const extendedTop = profit > 0 ? tax + netProfit + depreciation : 7;\\n    const topValue = Math.max(sales, extendedTop);\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - offsetY * 2) / (sales + extendedTop);\\n    const zeroY = fullHeight - topValue * unitHeight - offsetY;\\n    const salesY = zeroY + (topValue - sales) * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: salesY, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: salesY - variable * unitHeight, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: zeroY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: zeroY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: zeroY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: zeroY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const profitBlockY = zeroY + fixed * unitHeight;\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: 160,\\n      y: profitBlockY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: 320, y: profitBlockY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: 320, y: profitBlockY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = 400;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlockY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlockY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitBlockY + profitBlock.h, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: sales * unitHeight, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: sales * unitHeight, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: sales * unitHeight, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: sales * unitHeight + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    if (profit !== 0) {\\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? sales * unitHeight - profitHeight : sales * unitHeight + fixed * unitHeight;\\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n\\n      const profitBlock = {\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: profit < 0\\n      };\\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n      if (profit > 0) {\\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n        const netProfit = profit - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n      } else {\\n        blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n      }\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "ありがとうございます。現状の表示不具合を解消するため、次のように整理して進めます。\n\n### ✅ 表示ルールの再確認\n1. **売上**は最も下に配置される基準ブロック（Y=0起点）\n2. **粗利**の底辺は**売上の底辺と揃える**\n3. **変動費**は売上の**上に重なるように配置**\n4. その他のブロックは、粗利ブロックの上に積み上がる\n5. **利益がマイナス**のときは、粗利よりも**下に**追加で表示される\n\n---\n\n次にこのルールに完全に従って再描画されるように、コードを全面見直して再構築いたします。少しお待ちください。"
          ]
        },
