            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"30\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const margin = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n    const tax = profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 : 7;\\n    const netProfit = profit > 0 ? profit - tax : 0;\\n\\n    const topBlock = Math.max(variable, fixed + profit + tax + netProfit + depreciation);\\n    const bottomBlock = profit < 0 ? Math.abs(profit) + 7 : 0;\\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\\n    const totalValue = sales + topBlock + bottomBlock;\\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - margin * 2) / totalValue;\\n    const baseY = fullHeight - sales * unitHeight - margin;\\n\\n    const blocks = [];\\n    const xOffset = 40;\\n\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: baseY, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: baseY - variable * unitHeight, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY + sales * unitHeight - gross * unitHeight, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY + sales * unitHeight - fixed * unitHeight, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY + sales * unitHeight - fixed * unitHeight, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" });\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + sales * unitHeight - fixed * unitHeight + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" });\\n\\n    const profitY = profit >= 0 ? baseY + sales * unitHeight : baseY + sales * unitHeight - Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    blocks.push({ label: \\\"利益\\\", value: profit, x: 160, y: profitY, w: 160, h: Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight, color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\", redText: profit < 0 });\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const nextX = 320;\\n      const profitBottom = profitY + Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: nextX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: 400, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: 400, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: 320, y: profitY + Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const svg = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const centerOffset = (window.innerWidth - 40 - Math.max(...blocks.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

          "parts": [
            "以下のコードに戻してください\n\n<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang=\"ja\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"UTF-8\">\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\n  <script src=\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\"></script>\n  <style>\n    body {\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\n      margin: 20px;\n      text-align: center;\n    }\n    svg {\n      background-color: #fff;\n      border-radius: 12px;\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n    }\n    text {\n      font-size: 16px;\n      fill: #333;\n    }\n    .controls {\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\n    }\n    .controls label {\n      margin: 0 10px;\n    }\n    input {\n      width: 60px;\n    }\n  </style>\n</head>\n<body>\n\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\n<div class=\"controls\">\n  <label>売上 <input type=\"number\" id=\"sales\" value=\"120\"></label>\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"variable\" value=\"30\"></label>\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"personnel\" value=\"30\"></label>\n  <label>その他 <input type=\"number\" id=\"other\" value=\"50\"></label>\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"depreciation\" value=\"20\"></label>\n  <button onclick=\"drawChart()\">再描画</button>\n</div>\n\n<svg id=\"chart1\"></svg>\n\n<script>\n  const offsetX = 40;\n  const offsetY = 20;\n\n  function drawChart() {\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\n\n    const gross = sales - variable;\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\n\n    const fullHeight = window.innerHeight * 0.9;\n    const totalBlockValue =\n      sales +\n      variable +\n      gross +\n      fixed +\n      Math.abs(profit) +\n      (profit > 0 ? profit * 0.3 + (profit - profit * 0.3) + depreciation : 7);\n\n    const unitHeight = (fullHeight - offsetY * 2) / totalBlockValue;\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\n\n    const positions = {\n      sales: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 80 },\n      variable: { x: 80, y: 0, w: 240 },\n      baseY: baseY,\n      gross: { x: 80 },\n      fixed: { x: 160 },\n      personnel: { x: 240 },\n      other: { x: 240 },\n      profit: { x: 160 },\n      taxStartX: 320,\n      taxStep: 80\n    };\n\n    const blocks1 = [\n      { label: \"売上\", value: sales, x: positions.sales.x, y: positions.sales.y, w: positions.sales.w, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \"#E8F5E9\" },\n      { label: \"変動費\", value: variable, x: positions.variable.x, y: positions.variable.y, w: positions.variable.w, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \"#FFF3E0\" },\n      { label: \"粗利\", value: gross, x: positions.gross.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \"#E3F2FD\" },\n      { label: \"固定費\", value: fixed, x: positions.fixed.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \"#FFF9C4\" },\n      { label: \"人件費\", value: personnel, x: positions.personnel.x, y: positions.baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \"#DCEDC8\" },\n      { label: \"その他\", value: other, x: positions.other.x, y: positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \"#F0F4C3\" }\n    ];\n\n    const otherBottomY = positions.baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\n    const profitBlock = {\n      label: \"利益\",\n      value: profit,\n      x: positions.profit.x,\n      y: otherBottomY,\n      w: 160,\n      h: profitHeight,\n      color: profit < 0 ? \"#FFCDD2\" : \"#BBDEFB\",\n      redText: profit < 0\n    };\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\n\n    if (profit > 0) {\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\n\n      blocks1.push({ label: \"税金\", value: tax, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \"#FFE082\" });\n      blocks1.push({ label: \"税引後利益\", value: netProfit, x: positions.taxStartX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \"#C8E6C9\" });\n\n      const nextX = positions.taxStartX + positions.taxStep;\n      blocks1.push({ label: \"税引後利益\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \"#C8E6C9\" });\n      blocks1.push({ label: \"減価償却費\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitBlock.y + taxHeight -         "id": "c4b66434-9db2-4d24-a692-d0d84f38a723",
        "author": {
          "role": "user",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747029453.346,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "以下のコードに戻して\n\n<!DOCTYPE html>\r\n<html lang=\"ja\">\r\n<head>\r\n  <meta charset=\"UTF-8\">\r\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\r\n  <script src=\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\"></script>\r\n  <style>\r\n    body {\r\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\r\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\r\n      margin: 20px;\r\n      text-align: center;\r\n    }\r\n    svg {\r\n      background-color: #fff;\r\n      border-radius: 12px;\r\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\r\n    }\r\n    text {\r\n      font-size: 16px;\r\n      fill: #333;\r\n    }\r\n    .controls {\r\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\r\n    }\r\n    .controls label {\r\n      margin: 0 10px;\r\n    }\r\n    input {\r\n      width: 60px;\r\n    }\r\n  </style>\r\n</head>\r\n<body>\r\n\r\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\r\n<div class=\"controls\">\r\n  <label>売上 <input type=\"number\" id=\"sales\" value=\"120\"></label>\r\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"variable\" value=\"30\"></label>\r\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"personnel\" value=\"50\"></label>\r\n  <label>その他 <input type=\"number\" id=\"other\" value=\"50\"></label>\r\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\"number\" id=\"depreciation\" value=\"20\"></label>\r\n  <button onclick=\"drawChart()\">再描画</button>\r\n</div>\r\n\r\n<svg id=\"chart1\"></svg>\r\n\r\n<script>\r\n  const unitHeight = 5;\r\n  const marginX = 40;\r\n  const marginY = 20;\r\n\r\n  function drawChart() {\r\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\r\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\r\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\r\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\r\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\r\n\r\n    const gross = sales - variable;\r\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\r\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\r\n\r\n    const blocks1 = [\r\n      { label: \"売上\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \"#E8F5E9\" },\r\n      { label: \"変動費\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \"#FFF3E0\" },\r\n      { label: \"粗利\", value: gross, x: 80, y: 150, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \"#E3F2FD\" },\r\n      { label: \"固定費\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: 150, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \"#FFF9C4\" },\r\n      { label: \"人件費\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: 150, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \"#DCEDC8\" },\r\n      { label: \"その他\", value: other, x: 240, y: 150 + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \"#F0F4C3\" }\r\n    ];\r\n\r\n    if (profit !== 0) {\r\n      const otherBottomY = 150 + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\r\n      const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\r\n      const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : 150 + fixed * unitHeight;\r\n      const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\r\n\r\n      const profitBlock = {\r\n        label: \"利益\",\r\n        value: profit,\r\n        x: profitX,\r\n        y: profitY,\r\n        w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\r\n        h: profitHeight,\r\n        color: profit < 0 ? \"#FFCDD2\" : \"#BBDEFB\",\r\n        redText: profit < 0\r\n      };\r\n      blocks1.push(profitBlock);\r\n\r\n      if (profit > 0) {\r\n        const tax = profit * 0.3;\r\n        const netProfit = profit - tax;\r\n        const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\r\n        const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\r\n        const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\r\n\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"税金\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \"#FFE082\" });\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"税引後利益\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \"#C8E6C9\" });\r\n\r\n        const nextX = baseX + 80;\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"税引後利益\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \"#C8E6C9\" });\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"減価償却費\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \"#D1C4E9\" });\r\n      } else {\r\n        blocks1.push({ label: \"法人税\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \"#FFE0B2\" });\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\r\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\r\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\r\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\r\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\"#chart1\").attr(\"width\", svgWidth).attr(\"height\", fullHeight);\r\n    svg1.selectAll(\"*\").remove();\r\n\r\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \"売上\");\r\n    svg1.append(\"line\")\r\n      .attr(\"x1\", centerOffset)\r\n      .attr(\"x2\", window.innerWidth - 40)\r\n      .attr(\"y1\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\r\n      .attr(\"y2\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\r\n      .attr(\"stroke\", \"#666\")\r\n      .attr(\"stroke-width\", 2)\r\n      .attr(\"stroke-dasharray\", \"4,2\");\r\n\r\n    svg1.selectAll(\"rect\")\r\n      .data(blocks1)\r\n      .enter()\r\n      .append(\"rect\")\r\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\r\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + marginY)\r\n      .attr(\"width\", d => d.w)\r\n      .attr(\"height\", 0)\r\n      .attr(\"fill\", d => d.color)\r\n      .attr(\"stroke\", \"#333\")\r\n      .attr(\"stroke-width\", 2)\r\n      .attr(\"rx\", 4)\r\n      .transition()\r\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\r\n      .duration(800)\r\n      .attr(\"height\", d => d.h);\r\n\r\n    svg1.selectAll(\"text\")\r\n      .data(blocks1)\r\n      .enter()\r\n      .append(\"text\")\r\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\r\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\r\n      .attr(\"text-anchor\", \"middle\")\r\n      .attr(\"dominant-baseline\", \"middle\")\r\n      .style(\"fill\", d => d.redText ? \"#C62828\" : \"#333\")\r\n      .style(\"opacity\", 0)\r\n      .style(\"font-size\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \"10px\" : d.h < 60 ? \"12px\" : \"14px\"))\r\n      .transition()\r\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\r\n      .duration(500)\r\n      .style(\"opacity\", 1)\r\n      .text(d => d.label);\r\n\r\n    svg1.selectAll(\"text.value\")\r\n      .data(blocks1)\r\n      .enter()\r\n      .append(\"text\")\r\n      .attr(\"class\", \"value\")\r\n      .attr(\"x\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\r\n      .attr(\"y\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\r\n      .attr(\"text-anchor\", \"middle\")\r\n      .attr(\"dominant-baseline\", \"middle\")\r\n      .style(\"fill\", d => d.redText ? \"#C62828\" : \"#333\")\r\n      .style(\"opacity\", 0)\r\n      .style(\"font-size\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \"10px\" : d.h < 60 ? \"12px\" : \"14px\"))\r\n      .transition()\r\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\r\n      .duration(500)\r\n      .style(\"opacity\", 1)\r\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  drawChart();\r\n</script>\r\n\r\n</body>\r\n</html>\r"
          ]
        },

    "58b99231-3fd5-442d-ab44-5c3a86e78e93": {
      "id": "58b99231-3fd5-442d-ab44-5c3a86e78e93",
      "message": {
        "id": "58b99231-3fd5-442d-ab44-5c3a86e78e93",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747029778.955507,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitY = profit < 0 ? otherBottomY - profitHeight : baseY + fixed * unitHeight;\\n    const profitX = profit < 0 ? 320 : 160;\\n\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: profitX,\\n      y: profitY,\\n      w: profit < 0 ? 80 : 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": false,
        "weight": 1,

    "38d4af37-bd0e-4fa5-9e44-75734f972ba5": {
      "id": "38d4af37-bd0e-4fa5-9e44-75734f972ba5",
      "message": {
        "id": "38d4af37-bd0e-4fa5-9e44-75734f972ba5",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747029865.650418,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n    const profitY = otherBottomY;\\n    const profitX = 160;\\n\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: profitX,\\n      y: profitY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": false,

          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n\\n    let profitX = 160;\\n    let profitY = otherBottomY;\\n    if (profit < 0) {\\n      profitX = 320;\\n      profitY = baseY;\\n    }\\n\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: profitX,\\n      y: profitY,\\n      w: 160,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]

    "10667710-bed6-4b8f-9b1d-bea07ee873ba": {
      "id": "10667710-bed6-4b8f-9b1d-bea07ee873ba",
      "message": {
        "id": "10667710-bed6-4b8f-9b1d-bea07ee873ba",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747030156.371926,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginX = 40;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n\\n    let profitX = 160;\\n    let profitY = otherBottomY;\\n\\n    if (profit < 0) {\\n      profitX = 320;\\n      profitY = 0;\\n    }\\n\\n    const profitBlock = {\\n      label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n      value: profit,\\n      x: profitX,\\n      y: profitY,\\n      w: 80,\\n      h: profitHeight,\\n      color: profit < 0 ? \\\"#FFCDD2\\\" : \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n      redText: profit < 0\\n    };\\n    blocks1.push(profitBlock);\\n\\n    if (profit > 0) {\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const baseX = profitBlock.x + profitBlock.w;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n\\n      const nextX = baseX + 80;\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: nextX, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"法人税\\\", value: 7, x: profitX, y: profitY + profitHeight, w: 80, h: 7 * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFE0B2\\\" });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

            "ありがとうございます。現在のコードを元に、利益がマイナスの場合に\n\n- 「利益」ブロックを右に1つ追加で表示\n- その上に「減価償却費」ブロックを表示\n\nするように再構成した、正しく動作する安定版コードを以下に再生成します。"
          ]

    "c6784c9b-2388-42a5-8d47-fd065409fa18": {
      "id": "c6784c9b-2388-42a5-8d47-fd065409fa18",
      "message": {
        "id": "c6784c9b-2388-42a5-8d47-fd065409fa18",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747031381.306915,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n\\n    let profitX = 160;\\n    let profitY = otherBottomY;\\n\\n    if (profit >= 0) {\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: false\\n      });\\n\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const baseX = profitX + 160;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX + 80, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: baseX + 80, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      const lossX = 400;\\n      const baseY = sales * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: lossX,\\n        y: baseY,\\n        w: 80,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#FFCDD2\\\",\\n        redText: true\\n      });\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"減価償却費\\\",\\n        value: depreciation,\\n        x: lossX,\\n        y: baseY - depreciation * unitHeight,\\n        w: 80,\\n        h: depreciation * unitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\"\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

          ]
        },

    "d1f96f0a-5203-481b-af90-f489decc8266": {
      "id": "d1f96f0a-5203-481b-af90-f489decc8266",
      "message": {
        "id": "d1f96f0a-5203-481b-af90-f489decc8266",
        "author": {
          "role": "assistant",
          "name": null,
          "metadata": {}
        },
        "create_time": 1747031734.104738,
        "update_time": null,
        "content": {
          "content_type": "text",
          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \"svg1\\\\.selectAll\\\\(\\\"rect\\\"\\\\)[\\\\s\\\\S]*?\\\\.attr\\\\(\\\"height\\\", d => d\\\\.h\\\\);\",\n      \"replacement\": \"svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .on(\\\"mouseover\\\", function(event, d) {\\n        const tooltip = d3.select(\\\"body\\\").append(\\\"div\\\")\\n          .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"tooltip\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"position\\\", \\\"absolute\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"background\\\", \\\"#fff8dc\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"border\\\", \\\"1px solid #ccc\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"padding\\\", \\\"6px 10px\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"border-radius\\\", \\\"6px\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"pointer-events\\\", \\\"none\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"font-size\\\", \\\"13px\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"box-shadow\\\", \\\"0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"left\\\", event.pageX + 10 + \\\"px\\\")\\n          .style(\\\"top\\\", event.pageY - 20 + \\\"px\\\")\\n          .html(`<strong>${d.label}</strong><br/>金額: ${Math.round(d.value)}万円`);\\n      })\\n      .on(\\\"mouseout\\\", () => d3.select(\\\".tooltip\\\").remove())\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },
        "status": "finished_successfully",
        "end_turn": false,
        "weight": 1,

        "content": {

          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \"html\\\\(`\\\\<strong\\\\>\\\\$\\\\{d\\\\.label\\\\}\\\\<\\\\/strong\\\\>\\\\<br\\\\/\\\\>金額: \\\\$\\\\{Math\\\\.round\\\\(d\\\\.value\\\\)\\\\}万円`\\\\);\",\n      \"replacement\": \"html(`<strong>${d.label}</strong><br/>金額: ${Math.round(d.value)}万円<br/>率: ${sales > 0 ?           "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \"if \\\\(profit >= 0\\\\) \\\\{[\\\\s\\\\S]+?\\\\} else \\\\{\",\n      \"replacement\": \"if (profit >= 0) {\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: profitX,\\n        y: profitY,\\n        w: 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: false\\n      });\\n\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const baseX = profitX + 160;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: profitY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX + 80, y: profitY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: baseX + 80, y: profitY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      const lossX = 400;\\n      const baseY = sales * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: 320,\\n        y: baseY,\\n        w: 80,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#FFCDD2\\\",\\n        redText: true\\n      });\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: lossX,\\n        y: baseY,\\n        w: 80,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#FFCDD2\\\",\\n        redText: true\\n      });\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"減価償却費\\\",\\n        value: depreciation,\\n        x: lossX,\\n        y: baseY - depreciation * unitHeight,\\n        w: 80,\\n        h: depreciation * unitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\"\\n      });\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]
        },

          "parts": [
            "{\n  \"updates\": [\n    {\n      \"pattern\": \".*\",\n      \"replacement\": \"<!DOCTYPE html>\\n<html lang=\\\"ja\\\">\\n<head>\\n  <meta charset=\\\"UTF-8\\\">\\n  <title>お金のブロックパズル</title>\\n  <script src=\\\"https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js\\\"></script>\\n  <style>\\n    body {\\n      font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;\\n      background-color: #f8f9fa;\\n      margin: 20px;\\n      text-align: center;\\n    }\\n    svg {\\n      background-color: #fff;\\n      border-radius: 12px;\\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\\n    }\\n    text {\\n      font-size: 16px;\\n      fill: #333;\\n    }\\n    .controls {\\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\\n    }\\n    .controls label {\\n      margin: 0 10px;\\n    }\\n    input {\\n      width: 60px;\\n    }\\n  </style>\\n</head>\\n<body>\\n\\n<h2>お金のブロックパズル</h2>\\n<div class=\\\"controls\\\">\\n  <label>売上 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"sales\\\" value=\\\"120\\\"></label>\\n  <label>変動費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"variable\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <label>人件費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"personnel\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>その他 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"other\\\" value=\\\"50\\\"></label>\\n  <label>減価償却費 <input type=\\\"number\\\" id=\\\"depreciation\\\" value=\\\"20\\\"></label>\\n  <button onclick=\\\"drawChart()\\\">再描画</button>\\n</div>\\n\\n<svg id=\\\"chart1\\\"></svg>\\n\\n<script>\\n  const unitHeight = 5;\\n  const marginY = 20;\\n\\n  function drawChart() {\\n    const sales = +document.getElementById('sales').value;\\n    const variable = +document.getElementById('variable').value;\\n    const personnel = +document.getElementById('personnel').value;\\n    const other = +document.getElementById('other').value;\\n    const depreciation = +document.getElementById('depreciation').value;\\n\\n    const gross = sales - variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n\\n    if (profit >= 0) {\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: 160,\\n        y: otherBottomY,\\n        w: 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: false\\n      });\\n\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const baseX = 320;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: otherBottomY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: otherBottomY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX + 80, y: otherBottomY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: baseX + 80, y: otherBottomY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      const baseY = sales * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: 320,\\n        y: baseY,\\n        w: 80,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#FFCDD2\\\",\\n        redText: true\\n      });\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"減価償却費\\\",\\n        value: depreciation,\\n        x: 400,\\n        y: baseY - depreciation * unitHeight,\\n        w: 80,\\n        h: depreciation * unitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\"\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
          ]

variable;\\n    const fixed = personnel + other;\\n    const profit = gross - fixed;\\n\\n    const baseY = variable * unitHeight;\\n\\n    const blocks1 = [\\n      { label: \\\"売上\\\", value: sales, x: 0, y: 0, w: 80, h: sales * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E8F5E9\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"変動費\\\", value: variable, x: 80, y: 0, w: 240, h: variable * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF3E0\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"粗利\\\", value: gross, x: 80, y: baseY, w: 80, h: gross * unitHeight, color: \\\"#E3F2FD\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"固定費\\\", value: fixed, x: 160, y: baseY, w: 80, h: fixed * unitHeight, color: \\\"#FFF9C4\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"人件費\\\", value: personnel, x: 240, y: baseY, w: 80, h: personnel * unitHeight, color: \\\"#DCEDC8\\\" },\\n      { label: \\\"その他\\\", value: other, x: 240, y: baseY + personnel * unitHeight, w: 80, h: other * unitHeight, color: \\\"#F0F4C3\\\" }\\n    ];\\n\\n    const otherBottomY = baseY + personnel * unitHeight + other * unitHeight;\\n    const profitHeight = Math.abs(profit) * unitHeight;\\n\\n    if (profit >= 0) {\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: 160,\\n        y: otherBottomY,\\n        w: 160,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#BBDEFB\\\",\\n        redText: false\\n      });\\n\\n      const tax = profit * 0.3;\\n      const netProfit = profit - tax;\\n      const taxHeight = tax * unitHeight;\\n      const netHeight = netProfit * unitHeight;\\n      const baseX = 320;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税金\\\", value: tax, x: baseX, y: otherBottomY, w: 80, h: taxHeight, color: \\\"#FFE082\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX, y: otherBottomY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"税引後利益\\\", value: netProfit, x: baseX + 80, y: otherBottomY + taxHeight, w: 80, h: netHeight, color: \\\"#C8E6C9\\\" });\\n      blocks1.push({ label: \\\"減価償却費\\\", value: depreciation, x: baseX + 80, y: otherBottomY + taxHeight - depreciation * unitHeight, w: 80, h: depreciation * unitHeight, color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\" });\\n    } else {\\n      const lossX = 320;\\n      const lossY = sales * unitHeight;\\n\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"利益\\\",\\n        value: profit,\\n        x: lossX,\\n        y: lossY,\\n        w: 80,\\n        h: profitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#FFCDD2\\\",\\n        redText: true\\n      });\\n      blocks1.push({\\n        label: \\\"減価償却費\\\",\\n        value: depreciation,\\n        x: lossX + 80,\\n        y: lossY - depreciation * unitHeight,\\n        w: 80,\\n        h: depreciation * unitHeight,\\n        color: \\\"#D1C4E9\\\"\\n      });\\n    }\\n\\n    const maxHeight1 = Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.y + b.h));\\n    const fullHeight = Math.max(maxHeight1 + marginY * 2, 400);\\n    const svgWidth = window.innerWidth - 40;\\n    const centerOffset = (svgWidth - Math.max(...blocks1.map(b => b.x + b.w))) / 2;\\n    const svg1 = d3.select(\\\"#chart1\\\").attr(\\\"width\\\", svgWidth).attr(\\\"height\\\", fullHeight);\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"*\\\").remove();\\n\\n    const salesBlock = blocks1.find(b => b.label === \\\"売上\\\");\\n    svg1.append(\\\"line\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x1\\\", centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"x2\\\", window.innerWidth - 40)\\n      .attr(\\\"y1\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"y2\\\", salesBlock.h + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#666\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-dasharray\\\", \\\"4,2\\\");\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"rect\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + marginY)\\n      .attr(\\\"width\\\", d => d.w)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", 0)\\n      .attr(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.color)\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke\\\", \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"stroke-width\\\", 2)\\n      .attr(\\\"rx\\\", 4)\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200)\\n      .duration(800)\\n      .attr(\\\"height\\\", d => d.h);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY - 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => d.label);\\n\\n    svg1.selectAll(\\\"text.value\\\")\\n      .data(blocks1)\\n      .enter()\\n      .append(\\\"text\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"class\\\", \\\"value\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"x\\\", d => d.x + d.w / 2 + centerOffset)\\n      .attr(\\\"y\\\", d => d.y + d.h / 2 + marginY + 10)\\n      .attr(\\\"text-anchor\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .attr(\\\"dominant-baseline\\\", \\\"middle\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"fill\\\", d => d.redText ? \\\"#C62828\\\" : \\\"#333\\\")\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 0)\\n      .style(\\\"font-size\\\", d => (d.h < 30 ? \\\"10px\\\" : d.h < 60 ? \\\"12px\\\" : \\\"14px\\\"))\\n      .transition()\\n      .delay((d, i) => i * 200 + 800)\\n      .duration(500)\\n      .style(\\\"opacity\\\", 1)\\n      .text(d => Math.round(d.value));\\n  }\\n\\n  drawChart();\\n</script>\\n\\n</body>\\n</html>\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"

          ]
        },
